title: Project Engineer, Electrical Systems
description:
For our client, we are looking for a Project Engineer to join a highly skilled engineering team working with advanced power generation and energy solutions. This role focuses on generator protection and excitation systems, offering an excellent opportunity to build expertise in a specialized and growing area of the energy sector.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

You will participate in customer projects throughout their lifecycle, from engineering and system configuration to testing and commissioning. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will gradually take on broader technical responsibility and contribute to developing customer-specific solutions.

The position offers a combination of office-based engineering work and practical field activities at customer sites. As your expertise grows, you will also support technical discussions with customers and contribute to solution development activities.

Key Responsibilities:
· Engineering, configuration, and documentation of generator protection and excitation systems.
· Supporting testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), installation, and commissioning activities.
· Participating in commissioning assignments and technical troubleshooting at customer sites.
· Collaborating closely with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and customers to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
· Providing technical input for solution design and supporting sales and customer-facing activities when needed.

Requirements:
- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in electrical engineering, power generation, industrial automation, commissioning, or similar technical environments
- Good understanding of electrical power systems and interest in energy production technologies
- Experience with engineering, configuration, testing, or commissioning activities
- Knowledge of generator protection systems, protection relays, excitation systems, or power plant environments is considered an advantage
- Familiarity with electrical design tools is beneficial
- Strong communication and teamwork skills with a proactive, customer-oriented mindset
- Willingness to travel approximately 30 days per year, mainly within Finland and Northern Europe

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical, Automation or Power Engineering?*
- Do you have 2+ years of hands-on experience with electrical engineering, power systems, industrial automation, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you worked with generator protection systems, protection relays, excitation systems, or similar technologies?

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Vaasa (hybrid, minimum 1 day/week onsite)
Start: January 2027
Duration: Long-term assignment (12-month contracts, expected to continue for several years)
Allocation: 100 %
Languages: Fluent Finnish and English; Swedish is a plus

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

title: Senior Process Integration Engineer / Heat Recovery
description:
For our client were looking for a Senior Process Integration Engineer / Heat Recovery Specialist.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

The clients product portfolio is expanding, and they are looking for an experienced senior specialist to strengthen the development of heat pump and heat recovery solutions and the design of integrations in an industrial environment. The role is part of an international team of experts. They are not looking for a traditional process engineer, but an experienced integration designer who understands the complete process and piping system built around an industrial heat pump and has a hands-on approach to taking technology from concept to implementation.

Responsibilities:
 Design and implement integration solutions related to industrial heat pumps.
 Develop industrial heat recovery solutions and assess how recovered heat can be used efficiently.
 Design solutions where recovered energy is converted back into useful use.

Requirements:
 Strong experience in industrial processes, energy or heat pump solutions.

 Hands-on experience with the E3D design tool.
 Ability to prepare and interpret process diagrams (PFD, P&ID) and work according to industry standards.
 Experience in the technical integration of different systems and equipment.
 Experience in heat and steam systems of paper machines
 Insight into utilizing industrial waste heat and recycling energy

 Hands-on approach to taking technology from concept to implementation

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)

title: Senior IT Architect / Strategic Advisor
description:
Were seeking a Senior IT Architect / Strategic Advisor for our client.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Background:
Our client is planning a modernization of its production data and industrial IT architecture. The current environment consists of multiple systems, some of which are approaching end-of-life and require replacement or consolidation. The client has already reviewed several vendor solutions and is now looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to act as an independent, neutral advisor and sparring partner during the assessment and design phase. The consultant will help evaluate the current landscape, identify key challenges and opportunities, and support decision-making regarding future architecture, technology choices, and vendor ecosystem. The objective is a more standardized and controlled architecture that supports operational efficiency, data-driven decision-making, and future AI capabilities.

Responsibilities:
· Assess the current application and architecture landscape.
· Provide independent recommendations on future-state architecture and modernization options.
· Support decision-making related to technology platforms, vendors, and long-term architecture direction.
· Help define the problems to be solved and what the new architecture needs to achieve.
· Facilitate architecture discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.
· Help define architectural principles, priorities, and transformation roadmap.
· Identify opportunities to improve data utilization and prepare the environment for future AI-driven initiatives.
· Bring lessons learned from similar industrial transformation programs.

Requirements:
· Experience with production data and industrial IT architecture.
· Experience as a strategic advisor or sparring partner to senior decision-makers, including evaluating technology and vendor options neutrally and challenging proposals.
· Proven track record in large-scale industrial, energy, oil & gas, or process industry environments, with references from similar projects.
· Experience with complex enterprise application landscapes, including replacing legacy systems and consolidating them.
· Strong understanding of industrial data ecosystems and IT architecture.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have senior experience as an Enterprise Architect, IT Architect, or in a similar senior advisory role in oil and gas, energy, or another process or heavy industry?*
- Have you led or advised on the replacement of legacy systems and the consolidation of a complex production data or industrial IT landscape?*
- Have you acted as a strategic advisor or sparring partner to senior decision-makers, evaluating technology or vendor options neutrally?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. 

Language: Professional working proficiency in English.
Start date: November / December 2026
Duration: TBC, project to be completed be the end of Q1
Allocation: 50-100 %
Location: Espoo, Finland. Consultant should be ready to come onsite in the beginning of the assignment, after that remote work is possible.

title: Suksivuokraamotyöntekijä, asiakaspalvelija
description: Suksivuokraamon työntekijöitä – Peuramaa Ski, Kirkkonummi**Tykkäätkö vauhdista, talvesta ja ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä? Tule Peuramaalle töihin!**Peuramaa Ski etsii nyt reippaita, oma-aloitteisia ja asiakaspalveluhenkisiä työntekijöitä suksivuokraamoonsa talvikaudelle 2026–2027.Vuokraamossamme pääset työskentelemään keskellä laskettelukeskuksen toimintaa. Päivät ovat vaihtelevia, asiakkaita riittää ja tekemistä löytyy!**Meille tärkeintä ovat reipas asenne, ripeys ja halu tehdä töitä. Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi!**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?Suksivuokraamossa huolehdit siitä, että asiakkaat saavat sopivat ja turvallisesti käyttöön valmistellut lasketteluvälineet mahdollisimman sujuvasti.Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:- Laskettelu- ja lumilautavälineiden vuokraaminen - Asiakaspalvelu ja kassatyöskentely - Asiakkaiden auttaminen oikeiden välineiden valinnassa - Monojen, suksien ja lumilautojen käsittely - Välineiden säätäminen ja huoltaminen perehdytyksen mukaisesti - Vuokraamon järjestyksestä ja päivittäisestä toiminnasta huolehtiminen Mitä odotamme sinulta?- Reipasta ja positiivista asennetta - Ripeää ja tehokasta työskentelyotetta - Hyviä asiakaspalvelutaitoja - Oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullisuutta - Kykyä toimia kiireisessä ympäristössä - Valmiutta ilta- ja viikonlopputyöhön - Halua oppia uusia asioita Laskettelun ja lumilautailun tuntemus on etu, mutta aikaisempi kokemus suksivuokraamosta ei ole välttämätöntä.**Arvostamme erityisesti työntekijöitä, jotka tarttuvat toimeen, auttavat työkavereitaan ja pitävät homman liikkeessä myös kiireisimpinä hetkinä.**Mitä tarjoamme?- Vauhdikkaan ja mukavan työympäristön laskettelukeskuksessa - Monipuolisia ja aktiivisia työtehtäviä - Mukavan työporukan - Perehdytyksen tehtäviin ja välineisiin - Mahdollisuuden työskennellä talvikauden ajan - Työvuoroja pääasiassa iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin Työsuhteen tiedot**Työpaikka:** Peuramaa Ski, Peuramaantie 116, Kirkkonummi**Työsuhde:** Määräaikainen kausityö, talvikausi 2026–2027**Työaika:** Pääasiassa ilta- ja viikonlopputyötä**Aloitus:** Mahdollisimman pian / sopimuksen mukaanHae heti!**Tarvitsemme uusia työntekijöitä pikaisella aikataululla!**Lähetä meille lyhyt hakemus, jossa kerrot itsestäsi, mahdollisesta aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi sekä siitä, milloin voisit aloittaa.Et tarvitse pitkää työhistoriaa – hyvä asenne ja halu tehdä töitä ratkaisevat!**Hakemukset:** toimisto@peuramaa.fi**Lisätiedot:** 050-5555880**Tervetuloa Peuramaan talvitiimiin!**

title: Restaurant Cleaner – Temporary Assignment in Tornio and Turku

title: Myyntiedustaja (kodinturvaratkaisut)
description: **Haluatko myyntityön, jossa päiväsi eivät kulu kylmäsoittoihin tai asiakkaiden perässä juoksemiseen? Etsimme nyt myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijoita rooliin, jossa tärkein tehtäväsi on auttaa asiakkaita suojaamaan kotinsa ja yrityksensä Verisuren palveluilla.****Jos nautit tavoitteellisesta myynnistä, kaupan syntymisen tunteesta sekä asiakaskohtaamisista,rooli on juuri sinua varten.**Myynti ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijanamme et lähde liikkeelle tyhjästä. Jokaiselle päivällesi rakennetaan valmiiksi laadukkaita myyntimahdollisuuksia sovittujen asiakastapaamisten, nykyasiakaskäyntien sekä huoltojen ja asennusten kautta. Tavoitteena on yksinkertaisesti luoda mahdollisimman paljon onnistuneita kohtaamisia ja kauppoja.Tarjoamme sinulle 1500 € kuukausittaisen pohjapalkan, kannustavan palkkiomallin sekä Suomen tunnetuimman ja luotetuimman turvapalvelun myytäväksesi. Kun vahva brändi, toimiva konsepti ja jatkuva asiakasvirta yhdistyy, sinulle syntyy erinomaiset mahdollisuudet vaikuttaa omalla tekemiselläsi ansiotasoosi.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- **Varma pohjapalkka & motivoivat komissiot:** Tarjoamme sinulle **jatkuvan pohjapalkan 1500€/kk** sekä kannustavat ja motivoivat komissiot: uusista hankituista asiakkaista saat keskimäärin n. **300-400€ myyntikomission.** - **Lämpimät asiakaskohtaamiset:** Varmistamme sinulle riittävästi monipuolisia myynniin mahdollisuuksia niin valmiiksi sovittujen asiakastapaamisten kuin nykyasiakkailla tapahtuvien käyntien muodossa. - **Perehdytyksen, jota on hiottu yli 30 vuoden ajan:** Olemme kehittäneet koulutustamme sekä perehdytystämme pitkään, joten saat käyttöösi vinkit, neuvot ja tuen, joiden avulla onnistumisesi on vain sinusta itsestäsi kiinni. - **Autoetu:** Saat käyttöösi auton, jolla ajat niin työ- kuin vapaa-ajallasi. - **Eteneminen**: Kaikki myynnin esihenkilömme ovat aloittaneet myyjinä. Saat konkreettisen mahdollisuuden rakentaa uraasi eteenpäin. Sales Manager Naneten tarinaan pääse tutustumaan urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura). - **Best Place to Work sertifioidun organisaation.** Sijoituimme Suomen keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa parhaimpien joukkoon. Katso urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura) myyjiemme kokemuksia Verisurella työskentelemisestä. **Mitä päiväsi myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijana tarkemmin pitää sisällään?**Tyypillinen työpäiväsi alkaa esimerkiksi klo 10:00 tapaamisella, jossa asiakas odottaa sinua luoksensa. Onnistut tapaamisella vakuuttamaan hänet palvelusta, ja pääset sopimaan järjestelmän asennuksen heti huomiselle. Jatkat tästä päivääsi toisen asiakkaasi luokse, jossa suoritat hänen järjestelmänsä huollon. Järjestelmän huollon yhteydessä tarjoat parasta mahdollista palvelua ja selvität, onko asiakkaalla muita suojaamista kaipaavia kohteita, tai mahdollisesti tuttuja, joille hän haluaisi palvelua suositella.Päiväsi jatkuu mökkikohteella, jonne toteutat asennuksen, jonka olit sopinut viime viikolla turvattuasi ensin asiakkaan kotikohteen. Asennusten ja huoltojen yhteydessä kontaktoit myös lähialueen talot kartoittaaksesi uusia mahdollisia asiakkaita.Viikkosi koostuu monipuolisesti erilaisista kohtaamisista niin uusien kuin nykyisten asiakkaiden kanssa, sisältäen tapaamisia, asennuksia, huoltoja ja lähialueen suoraa asiakaskontaktointia. Tärkein tehtäväsi on siis toteuttaa mahdollisimman monen uuden kodin ja yritystilan suojaaminen Verisuren palvelulla.**Työaikasi on pääsääntöisesti ma–pe klo 10:00–18:00.** Työ on aktiivista kenttätyötä, joten tiimipalavereja ja koulutuksia lukuun ottamatta toimit pääsääntöisesti kentällä asiakkaidesi luona.**Voisiko tämä olla sinun seuraava uramahdollisuus?**Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa motivaatiota tavoitteellista myyntityötä kohtaan sekä erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja. Aiemmat näytöt suoramyynnin parista katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ne eivät ole välttämättömyys. Työssä tehtävät asennukset ja huollot eivät vaadi aiempaa kokemusta, sillä koulutamme sinut niihin.**Tehtävässä edellytämme sinulta:**- Ajokorttia: Tarvitset B-kortin (manuaali) ja täysikäisyyttä. - Sujuvia vuorovaikutustaitoja suomen kielellä. - Pystyt työskentelemään joustavasti arkisin 10:00-18:00 välillä. - Tausta: Edellytämme on nuhteetonta rikostaustaa (edellytys turvasuojaajakortille). **Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**Jos uusi myyntiroolimme sytytti kiinnostukseksi, klikkaa linkkiä, jätä CV sekä yhteystietosi, jonka jälkeen olemme sinuun yhteydessä. Paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fiKatso tulevien kollegoidesi ajatuksia urasivuiltamme ja lisätiedot sosiaalisesti mediasta Instagramista & TikTokista @verisurelaiset.

title: Health and Safety Manager/Health and Safety Assistant Manager / Admin (Data Centre )
description: HSE Manager & HSE Assistant Manager – Data Centre Construction Project**Location:** Vihti, Finland**Company:** Mono Rakennus Oy**Project:** Data Centre**Employment Type:** Full-time, Fixed-term (12–15 months)**Open Positions:** 2We are currently looking for two qualified HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) professionals for a major international data centre construction project in Vihti, Finland.**Position 1:** HSE Manager (1 Position)**Key Responsibilities:**- Lead and manage daily HSE operations on the construction site. - Ensure compliance with Finnish occupational health and safety legislation and project-specific safety requirements. - Develop, implement and monitor HSE procedures, policies and safety management systems. - Prepare, review and approve Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS) within the scope of assigned authority. - Conduct site inspections, safety audits and risk assessments. - Investigate incidents, accidents and near misses, and implement corrective actions. - Coordinate safety inductions, toolbox talks and HSE training. - Monitor subcontractor compliance with safety regulations. - Attend HSE meetings and coordinate with the general contractor and other project stakeholders. - Prepare regular HSE performance reports and maintain safety records. - Prepare lifting plans and other required plans for different activities. **Requirements:**- Relevant degree, diploma or professional qualification in occupational health and safety, or engineering background. - Minimum 1 years of relevant HSE experience, preferably in construction. - Experience in large-scale industrial or data centre construction projects. - Strong knowledge of Finnish occupational health and safety legislation. - Experience with RAMS, inspections, audits and incident investigations. - Excellent communication and organisational skills. - Good command of English. - Valid Finnish Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti). - NEBOSH, IOSH certification or equivalent HSE qualification is considered an advantage. **Position 2:** HSE Assistant Manager / Administrator (1 Position)**Key Responsibilities:**- Support the HSE Manager in daily site safety operations. - Assist with site inspections, audits and safety monitoring. - Prepare and maintain HSE documentation, reports and records. - Support the preparation and administration of RAMS. - Coordinate safety inductions, toolbox talks and training records. - Maintain incident reports, safety observations and corrective action registers. - Assist in monitoring subcontractor compliance with site safety requirements. - Organise HSE meetings, prepare minutes and follow up on action items. - Maintain and update electronic HSE management systems. - Support communication between the HSE team, site management and subcontractors. **Requirements:**- Relevant education or professional experience in occupational health and safety, construction or administration. - Previous experience in an HSE support, coordination or construction administration role. - Good understanding of construction site safety procedures. - Strong organisational, reporting and documentation skills. - title: Electrical Designers for Data Center, Industrial and Building Services Projects, AINS group, Espoo
description: Welcome to AINS Group, a forward-thinking engineering and consulting company specialising in the built environment. At AINS Group, we foster a culture where our experts and clients can succeed together. We offer the opportunities and benefits of a large company combined with the straightforward, approachable culture of a smaller organisation and an inspiring, award-winning work community.Come build a better future with us!We are looking for Electrical Designers to strengthen our community of industrial and building services experts in Espoo, Finland.At AINS Group, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse and technically interesting projects, designing functional, safe and energy-efficient electrical solutions that meet our clients needs. Depending on your experience and expertise, your projects may focus on data centers, industrial facilities, building electrical systems or hospital environments.As an Electrical Designer, you will work on a variety of electrical design and specialist assignments as part of multidisciplinary project teams. You will design functional, safe and practical electrical systems that take into account the specific requirements of each project and operating environment. In data center and other critical infrastructure projects, particular emphasis is placed on the reliability and uninterrupted operation of electrical systems.The variety of our projects and AINS Groups extensive network of experts give you the opportunity to work in different operating environments and on diverse design assignments.We would be happy to hear what kind of expertise and experience you would bring to our team. The exact content and focus of the role can be tailored according to your skills, experience and professional interests.What we expect from you- a suitable technical degree, such as a Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering- previous experience in electrical design- experience with MagiCAD and/or Revit- good collaboration and communication skills- a good command of English for professional purposes.The role can be performed in English, and Finnish language skills are not required. Finnish language skills are considered an advantage. Previous experience in data center projects is also considered an advantage.What will help you succeed in this roleA curious mindset, attention to detail and a willingness to continuously develop both your own expertise and project practices will support your success in the role. We expect an independent and responsible approach to work as well as the confidence to contribute your professional expertise and views.At AINS Group, we trust our experts, and no one is expected to know or solve everything alone. We ask questions, exchange ideas and share our expertise.We invest in you and your work communityWe want our people to have the opportunity to develop their expertise and build career paths that reflect their individual strengths and ambitions. You will be supported by a skilled and encouraging work community as well as an extensive network of experts with whom you can solve demanding design challenges.AINS Group is recognised as one of Finlands most attractive employers among engineering professionals (Universum 2026). Our sense of community is also visible in everyday working life: our offices gather for a shared breakfast every weekday morning, and colleagues connect not only at their desks but also over shared lunches and afternoon coffee.In addition to flexible ways of working, we offer comprehensive occupational healthcare, a bonus scheme, a lunch benefit and a flexible wellbeing benefit that can be used for sports, culture, commuting or massage. Our benefits also include a company bicycle scheme and shared sports and wellbeing activities.At AINS Group, you can build your own career path by deepening your specialist expertise, as career development does not have to mean moving into a management role. You will have the opportunities of a large company around you, combined with a work community where people work together, trust one anothers expertise and are encouraged to share their views.Employment details- Start date: As agreed.- Employment and working hours: Permanent, full-time employment, 37.5 hours per week. Flexible working hours between 6:00–9:00 and 15:00–18:00.- Working model: Flexible hybrid work, with opportunities and encouragement to work together at the office.- Location: Espoo, Finland.- Employer: AINS Group.Interested?The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation between AINS Group and StaffPoint. title: Driver (D1/D), Pyhätunturi, Lapland, Finland
description: **Join our team as a Driver in Pyhätunturi!**Were looking for a Driver for the upcoming winter season, whose main responsibility will be safari and shuttle transport for our guests. Your background can be in professional driving, or in activity guiding where transporting guests has been part of your role. The exact duties will be tailored to the skills of the selected person.As our Driver, you are often the first and last person our guests meet, so a safe driving style matters just as much as warm, professional service.Sunday Morning Collection offers premium accommodation, dining and outdoor experiences in the breathtaking surroundings of Pyhä-Luosto National Park. We operate according to the principles of sustainable tourism, with safety and authentic experiences at the heart of everything we do.**Your main responsibilities / transport:**- Safari transport: driving guests to and from activity sites - Shuttle transport within the Pyhätunturi area - Airport transfers and private transfers as needed - Welcoming and assisting guests, including help with luggage - Daily vehicle checks, cleanliness, refuelling and charging - Driving safely and punctually in changing winter conditions **Depending on your skills, also maintenance duties:**- General maintenance and support duties around the resort area - Heating and maintaining our lakeside saunas - Preparing and servicing activity equipment, including electric snowmobiles, skis and snowshoes **Requirements:**- A valid Category D1 or D driving licence and a Driver Certificate of Professional Competence - Experience transporting passengers, either as a professional driver or in activity/outdoor tourism; winter driving experience is a strong advantage - A safe, calm and responsible driving style - An excellent customer service attitude and strong communication skills - Fluent English; Finnish is a significant advantage and additional languages are appreciated **Considered an advantage:**- Experience in property maintenance or technical support work - Experience in activity guiding, outdoor tourism or wilderness guiding - A First Aid (EA1) certificate (training provided if needed) - Good physical fitness and the ability to work outdoors in all weather conditions **What we offer:**- A varied role where no two days are ever the same - The chance to try our experiences free of charge, so you know first-hand what our guests enjoy - Staff benefits on our own products and services - Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort - A friendly, professional and close-knit team - Comprehensive onboarding before the season begins and training for our activities - Affordable staff accommodation, if required - Comprehensive occupational healthcare - The opportunity to work for a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company - An excellent workplace location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services - Salary according to the Finnish Programme Services Collective Agreement (Job Requirement Group B, approx. 2,095 - 2,337€/month). The final salary is based on your experience and the focus of your duties. **Employment details**The position begins in early December 2026, or as agreed, and continues until the end of the 2027 spring season (late March / early April). This is a full-time seasonal position.**About us**Sunday Morning Collection is a Finnish family-owned company offering premium accommodation, dining and activity experiences in Pyhä-Luosto National Park. During the winter season we organise electric snowmobile safaris, Northern Lights experiences, snowshoe adventures, ice fishing excursions, farm visits and more. Sunday Morning Collection also includes Sunday Morning Resort, Parkside Pyhä Apartments and Restaurant Aihki.**Interested?**Send your application with the subject Driver / Your Name to rekry@sundaymorning.fi, together with your CV and salary expectation. Tell us about your licence categories, your passenger transport experience and why youd like to spend the winter with our team.The application period ends on 29 November 2026 at 23:59 (Finnish time). We review applications as they arrive, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.Applications & enquiries: rekry@sundaymorning.fi | www.sundaymorning.fi

title: Vaihtoautomyyjä Lempäälä

title: IT Manager - Service management
description: Sandvik is a global, high-tech engineering group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability, and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. We are at the forefront of digitalization and focus on optimizing our customers processes. Our world-leading offering includes equipment, tools, services and digital solutions for machining, mining, rock excavation, and rock processing. In 2025, the group had approximately 42.000 employees, sales in more than 150 countries and revenues of about SEK 121 billion.Our Sandvik Mining and Rock Solutions (SMR) IT Delivery organization supports end to end business processes with solutions by providing solution design & architecture, project implementation, and service operations.We are now looking for IT Manager - Customer Portal. The position is permanent and preferred location is Tampere, Finland, where several key business stakeholders and Sandvik divisions are located.Your Mission as IT Manager (Service Owner)As an IT Manager, you will lead a team of Sandvik employees and contractors at the same time while acting as the Service Owner for a portfolio of business-critical services, including the My Sandvik Customer Portal, eBusiness solutions covering integrated customer ordering channels and B2B ERP transactions, customer-specific integration solutions, and technical documentation management services such as the Documoto document storage platform, ensuring they deliver business value, excellent user experiences, and reliable global operations.You ensure these services deliver business value, excellent user experiences, and reliable global operations while driving their continuous development and performance. Acting as the key link between business stakeholders, Product Owners, architects, development teams, suppliers, and service providers, you lead service delivery, governance, capacity planning, financial control, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.In your Service Owner capacity, you are accountable for ensuring these services deliver business value, excellent user experiences, reliable global operations, and continuous improvement. You will oversee service performance, governance, capacity planning, financial control, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.At the same time, you will provide day-to-day leadership and direction for a team consisting of Sandvik employees and contractors, fostering collaboration, engagement, and strong execution. While supplier-managed service teams are led operationally by their respective suppliers, you will own the service relationship and ensure that suppliers deliver according to agreed service levels, contractual commitments, business expectations, and strategic objectives.Acting as the key link between business stakeholders, Product Owners, architects, development teams, suppliers, and service providers, you will drive service excellence, governance, and continuous improvement across the entire service portfolio.What can you bring to our team?We are looking for an experienced IT Manager with strong expertise in IT service management, stakeholder leadership, vendor management, and budget responsibility. You have a proven track record of managing business-critical IT services in a global environment and can balance business needs, service delivery, governance, supplier relationships, and continuous service development.You build trusted relationships across international stakeholder networks and work proactively to drive results. While not necessarily a hands-on technical specialist, you are comfortable discussing integrations, application landscapes, security requirements, and service roadmaps with both business and technical audiences.We value leaders who take ownership, challenge the status quo, and continuously improve services, ways of working, and team performance. The ability to lead through influence, foster collaboration, and create business value in a complex global environment is essential for success in this role.Key qualifications· 5+ years of experience in Functional Manager, IT Service Owner/Manager, Application Manager, Product Owner, or similar roles· Proven experience in Service Management, including ITSM and ITIL processes, workflow development, service tools, and SLA/OLA management.· Strong financial management experience, including budgeting, forecasting, cost monitoring, cost optimization, and communicating financial impacts to stakeholders. Accounting knowledge is considered an advantage.· Ability to work effectively with Product Owners, business stakeholders, architects, and development teams in agile development environments.· Ability to bridge business and technology by translating architectural vision into practical solutions.· Experience with ERP, CRM, B2B eCommerce, EDI, sales and invoicing processes, preferably in large, integration-heavy enterprise environments.· Familiarity with Ariba, Peppol, Coupa, or similar integration platforms.· Ability to drive initiatives independently in a globally distributed organization.· Experience of leading through influence rather than direct authority is highly appreciated.· Experience in IT supplier management and IT service agreements· You hold self-driven, goal-oriented, agile mindset.· You have an ability to operate independently and effectively in a dynamic environment.· Bachelors or masters degree in IT, Business, Engineering, or a related field· Fluent English language skills· Finnish or Swedish language skills are beneficial but not required.Required Tools & Technologies· Jira & Confluence· ServiceNow· Power BI· Microsoft Office Suite· SAP Ariba (customer order management)· Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, Peppol, .NET will be advantages.· Azure knowledge is a plusSandvik will offer you - A glimpse of our cultureSandvik will offer an opportunity for you to influence and structure our organization with new and innovative ways of working, good perks, flexible hybrid work, and an opportunity to continuously learn with a good work-life balance. Company has a truly international environment with great opportunities for your professional development and growth.We have an inclusive company...

title: Chef, Restaurant Aihki, Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland
description: **Join the team at Restaurant Aihki in Pyhätunturi!**We are looking for a **Chef** to join Restaurant Aihki for the winter season 2026 - 2027, as part of Sunday Morning Resort in Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland.Restaurant Aihki is known for its high-quality modern Nordic cuisine, where pure, locally sourced ingredients take centre stage. Our restaurant has twice been recognised among **Finland's Best Restaurants** by _Kauppalehti Optio_ (2022 & 2023, rating 16+).As a Chef at Restaurant Aihki, you will work as part of our professional kitchen team and take an active role in daily food preparation and service. You will work with high-quality ingredients and help ensure that every dish leaving the kitchen meets Aihki's high standards.This position is ideal for a chef with a few years of professional kitchen experience who is looking to develop their skills in a high-quality restaurant environment. Experience in à la carte, fine dining or Nordic cuisine is considered an advantage, but most importantly, we are looking for a professional attitude, a strong team spirit and a genuine passion for great food.**Your responsibilities include:**- Preparing and presenting dishes according to Restaurant Aihki's standards - Working across different kitchen stations during daily service - Preparing and handling ingredients - Following Aihki's recipes, procedures and quality standards - Ensuring the quality, proper storage and rotation of ingredients - Following kitchen hygiene, food safety and self-monitoring procedures - Keeping your workstation clean, organised and ready for service - Working closely with the rest of the kitchen and front-of-house teams **We are looking for someone who has:**- Approximately 2-3 years of professional kitchen experience - A relevant culinary qualification or equivalent practical experience - Experience in an à la carte restaurant; fine dining or Nordic cuisine experience is considered an advantage - Strong fundamental cooking skills and an interest in high-quality ingredients - An organised, responsible and proactive approach to work - The ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment - Good teamwork and communication skills - Good spoken English; Finnish and other languages are considered an advantage - Motivation to learn and continue developing professionally - Above all, a positive attitude and genuine passion for high-quality food **We offer you:**- The opportunity to work in one of Finland's highly regarded restaurants - The opportunity to develop your skills in modern Nordic cuisine - An inspiring working environment surrounded by the beautiful landscapes of Pyhätunturi, Finnish Lapland - The support of a welcoming, professional and international team - Comprehensive onboarding before your employment begins - The possibility of staff accommodation close to the workplace - Comprehensive occupational healthcare and local employee benefits - Access to shared company season passes for Pyhä Ski Resort - Employee benefits for selected activities - The opportunity to work for a Sustainable Travel Finland certified company - An excellent location close to Pyhä Ski Resort and local services - A competitive salary based on your experience and skills, with the MARA collective agreement as the basis for salary **Employment**The position begins in **mid-November 2026** and continues until the **end of March 2027**.This is a **full-time seasonal position**, approximately **40 hours per week**, with two days off per week. Shifts are mainly scheduled in the afternoon and evening.Working a winter season in Pyhä also means experiencing the Arctic winter, snowy fells and the unique atmosphere of Finnish Lapland right outside your workplace.**About us****Sunday Morning Collection is a Finnish family-owned tourism company** offering high-quality accommodation, dining and activity experiences in the breathtaking surroundings of Pyhä-Luosto National Park.Sustainability is at the heart of what we do. We are committed to developing tourism responsibly, respecting the unique nature of Lapland and working closely with local businesses and partners.As an employer, we believe in a positive working atmosphere, open communication, strong team spirit and opportunities for professional growth. With us, you'll work with international guests in the beautiful surroundings of Pyhätunturi as part of a skilled and close-knit team.Restaurant Aihki is the restaurant of Sunday Morning Resort, combining the flavours and local ingredients of Lapland with contemporary Scandinavian influences. Throughout the season, we also organise themed dining events and guest chef evenings.Discover Restaurant Aihki on Instagram **@restaurantaihki** and at **sundaymorning.fi/restaurant-aihki**.**Interested?**Please send your application with the subject line **Chef Aihki / \[Your Name\]**, together with your CV and salary expectation.Tell us about your background, professional experience and why you would like to spend the upcoming winter season as part of the Aihki team.We review applications throughout the recruitment period, so we encourage you to apply early.**Applications and enquiries:**- rekry@sundaymorning.fi - sundaymorning.fi

title: Digital Growth Marketing Manager
description: _Fastems is a global partner for machining manufacturers, delivering intelligent automation for cutting machine tools and surrounding processes. We are a family-owned business with 40 years of automation experience, over 5000 installations and main markets in Europe, North America and Asia. Our mission is to help metalworking manufacturers improve their productivity and profitability. Globally, there are already 450 of us learning, growing and prospering together. At Fastems you get to work with some of the brightest people in the industry, so every day is an opportunity to learn something new._We are looking for a **Digital Growth Marketing Manager** to join our global marketing team and drive growth through digital channels. You will own our growth marketing engine and keep optimizing and improving it based on data and AI. We are looking for someone who really loves digital marketing, has a proactive working style, and thinks systematically and creatively. You bring a positive attitude, a collaborative mindset and a good sense of humour. A little spark in your eyes doesnt hurt either.**What will you get to work on?****Marketing automation & CRM**You will own and continuously develop our lead pipeline in Salesforce Sales Cloud, helping marketing and sales work smoothly together. You will also support localized prospecting activities and develop marketing automation, lead nurturing and customer engagement journeys across Marketing Cloud and Service Cloud.**Website, SEO & GEO**You will take ownership of our new website (which will be published soon) built on WordPress, and develop it further with our web partner. Your focus is SEO and GEO visibility, digital customer journeys, conversion and analytics – ensuring a site that drives engagement.**Growth marketing**You will drive demand generation through LinkedIn, Meta, SEO/GEO, SEM, and other digital channels. You create, run, measure and optimize campaigns based on collected data. The target is qualified demand and a real contribution to sales, not just traffic.**Marketing AI**You will lead the development of our marketing AI strategy and turn promising ideas into practical solutions. You will identify where AI creates business value, help define the required data, technologies and integrations, and work with partners to make it happen. Quality, security and human oversight remain important throughout.**Analytics & performance**You will build visibility across the marketing and sales funnel. Your insights will help us understand what creates qualified demand, what converts, what needs improvement and where we should invest next.**Who will you work with?**You will have a lot of ownership, but you are not on your own. You work closely with colleagues in marketing, sales, product management, and with external partners. You are in charge of digital strategy and implementation, working closely with your teammates who lead content creation.**What will you bring with you?**- A hands-on digital marketing enthusiast who thinks systemically, enjoys working with data and technology and wants to understand what really drives business results - Strategic and analytical person who can both plan and execute - Curiosity about AI, marketing technology and new ways of working - with business value first in mind - Good project management and teamwork skills - Proactive and independent way of working - 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, MarTech or a similar role - Fluent in English and at least basic Finnish skills for everyday workplace - Experience in international B2B marketing of technically complex products, manufacturing or industrial automation is a plus **Location and ways of working**Our office is located in **Lahdesjärvi, Tampere**. We offer flexible hybrid working and the possibility to work partly remotely. However, this role also requires regular on-site presence in Tampere to support close collaboration with the team and key stakeholders.**We can offer you:**- A key role in shaping digital growth at a global industrial automation company. - Fastems strong company culture expressed through our values. - Career and development opportunities. - International work atmosphere and global activities. - Flexible working hours and possibility to work partly remotely. - Comprehensive employee benefits, such as culture and lunch benefit at the office. **Interested in joining #fastemsians?**For more information about the position and the recruitment process, please contact:Teemu-Pekka Ahonen / Head of Product Management & Marketing: teemu.ahonen@fastems.comSend your application together with your CV and salary request **by November 29th at the latest.** Please note that even though the application deadline is not reached, we may proceed with interviews and make a hire as soon as a suitable candidate is identified.

title: FA Solutions: Solution Consultant (Fintech SaaS, Riga or Helsinki)
description: **Type**: Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki / Riga**Application deadline:** 29.11.2026Are you passionate about finance, technology and helping clients succeed? Join FA Solutions growing team as a **Solution Consultant** and turn complex business needs into practical solutions!FA Solutions is a market leading provider of software for Asset & Wealth Managers, helping them manage their investments globally. The company offers a cloud-based Portfolio Management solution that automates and centralizes a wide range of operational processes into one easy-to-use FA Platform.FA Solutions is committed to delivering a robust and scalable solution that prioritises user experience, data security, and compliance, allowing the client companies to leverage the power of open architecture and interoperability.**What will you be doing?**As a Solution Consultant, you will play a central role in helping FAs new clients to start running their business on FA platform and to help FAs existing clients to get the most out of the FA system capabilities.The role combines project management, investment management knowledge and technical problem-solving, with a strong emphasis on client relationships and delivering business value.**Your work will cover the full delivery lifecycle:**- Taking ownership of designing new client-specific solutions by mapping business requirements with the platforms capabilities and best practices - Configuring and customizing the platform to meet client needs, including light scripting and data migration - Coordinating implementation projects, communicating progress, and ensuring delivery quality - Conducting workshops and training sessions for client users - Contributing to improvement projects for existing clients, from gap analysis to delivery You'll collaborate closely with account management, product management, customer support and delivery partners, while maintaining an active dialogue with clients throughout the projects.You will manage several long-term projects simultaneously and work closely with clients, particularly in the UK and Iceland.**What makes you a great fit?**You will work with various stakeholders and clients, which highlights the importance of excellent communication and collaboration skills. As your work will cover the full delivery lifecycle, you'll also need basic project management skills, a structured way of working, and the ability to deliver training sessions and host workshops.You might be the talent we are looking for if you enjoy bringing people, processes and technology together. You can confidently lead client discussions, structure complex requirements and keep projects moving forward. You are curious about how financial businesses operate and motivated to learn new software solutions. You do not need to be a programmer to succeed in this role.**We require you to have:**- Minimum 2 years of experience in consulting, software implementation, professional services or client-facing project delivery - Good understanding of financial services or investment management, or a strong interest in developing your expertise in the field - A genuine interest in working with clients and the ability to succeed in a customer-facing environment - Experience coordinating projects, managing stakeholders and translating business requirements into practical solutions - A full professional proficiency and presentation skills in English **We consider as an asset:**- Experience in investment management industry - Knowledge of Agile and Waterfall project methodologies - Experience with Jira or similar project management tools - Some experience in scripting (Java, JavaScript, SQL or similar) **FA Solutions offers you:**- The opportunity to own meaningful client projects and see how your work improves financial institutions' everyday operations - A collaborative international team where you can learn from experienced colleagues and work with clients across different markets - Room to grow into a senior consulting, team leadership or specialist role as your expertise develops - The flexibility and speed of a startup, backed by the resources and stability of an established company - Flexible working hours and remote work policy - Auntie well-being service, occupational health care in Finland, health insurance in Latvia - Bonus model **Practicalities:**This is a full-time and permanent position, in which you will be employed directly to FA Solutions.You will join the Professional Services team either in **Helsinki, Finland,** or **Riga, Latvia**, depending on your current location and preference. The role also includes a flexible hybrid arrangement. The role involves occasional international travel, particularly to the UK and Iceland, depending on client projects.The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.Salary in this position is approximately 3000-4500 €/month based on your experience.**Does this sound like the next step in your career?**Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English latest by the 29th of November via aTalent's application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/397753/create/.Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.You can familiarize yourself with FA Solutions here: https://fasolutions.com. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Kiira Dahlström (+358 44 902 0238, kiira.dahlstrom\[at\]atalent.fi).

title: Full Stack Developer (C#, .NET, JavaScript, SQL), Wärtsilä
description: About the roleAs a Full Stack Developer, you will join a dynamic 11-person team dedicated to upgrading and maintaining Wärtsilä's global sales tools. Your primary focus will be a migration project, translating legacy product configurator code into modern languages to support global marine sales.In this role, you will focus on developing, maintaining, and modernizing Wärtsiläs internal global sales tools, quotation systems, and rule-based product configurators. As Wärtsiläs business is growing rapidly, the team is currently executing a key upgrade project to ensure sales teams have modern, high-performing tools at their disposal. Your primary focus will be translating and migrating existing Visual Basic-based configurator logic into modern web technologies using C# (.NET), JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.You will join a team of 11 professionals. Because the tools are directly tied to Wärtsiläs engine portfolio, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Product Management, and R&amp;D to verify requirements and ensure seamless functionality.Work tasks- Translate existing product configurator code from Visual Basic to JavaScript, HTML, and C#- Develop new features and maintain global sales tools, quotation systems, and SQL databases- Collaborate actively with Sales, Product Management, and R&D stakeholders to clarify business rules and technical requirements- Participate in system testing, troubleshooting, and hyper-care support following project milestones- Provide hyper-support and maintenance for the newly upgraded tools post-launchWe are looking for- A few years of relevant work experience in FullStack development, specifically C# (.NET), JavaScript, HTML, and CSS- Good practical knowledge of relational databases and SQL- Fluent English skills- Strong self-direction and proactive communication skills, with the confidence to network internally and ask questions when troubleshooting complex logicIt is meritorious if you have- Previous experience working at WärtsiläOther information:Start: In December or in JanuaryLocation: Preferably Vaasa, Helsinki (occasional visits to Vaasa)Employment period: At least untill the end of 2027, extension possible&nbsp;Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Senior Sales Manager – Industrial Digitalization Solutions
description: Are you passionate about industrial digitalization sales and a persistent customer value builder – do you have an innovative and proactive approach in driving business growth, bringing new perspectives and finding new solutions for industrial companies?Etteplan is growing and we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Manager to join us. You get energy from working with customers, and act as an example to inspire your colleagues to meet customer expectations. - A minimum of five years of proven success in international business solution sales within the engineering or technology services industry, specifically in selling to industrial customers in manufacturing, production, and R&amp;D environments. - Proven B2B sales track record in industrial platform and software solutions. Scope of platform and SW offering ranges from initial concept and roadmap development to full deployment, integration, and lifecycle management. - Wide network of contacts among industrial manufacturing companies. We value particularly your professional network among manufacturing companies operating in defense, energy, mining, heavy machinery and autonomous vehicles sectors. - Strong end-to-end sales capability covering the full sales lifecycle; Building and actively managing a healthy sales pipeline, driving proactive customer engagement and consultative dialogue, leading and coordinating bid teams across disciplines, shaping competitive, value-based commercial and technical offers, delivering compelling executive- and technical-level presentations, and leading contract negotiations and closing agreements. - Strong domain expertise in industrial software and platform technologies as foundation for industrial digitalization. Solid understanding of industrial IT/OT environments and platform solution domains, enabling credible, value-driven engagement with customers. Ability to translate technical capabilities into business value, positioning solutions in the context of customers production strategies, aftersales processes, digitalization roadmaps, and competitiveness goals. - A natural relationship builder with a proactive, hands-on, analytical, and customer-centric approach to work - Masters degree in technology or economics or other relevant academic degree - Fluency in both Finnish and English is a must-have, proficiency in German or Swedish appreciated.Your way of working is best described as proactive, working well under pressure and being eager to achieve successful sales results – you work with integrity, transparency and trust. - An entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for new solutions - A motivated person able to energize others in a positive manner and create solutions - Creative and open-minded with skills to work across boundaries with the sales team and the operative organization - A self-starter with the initiative to make things happen.What to expect This is a great opportunity to work in an exciting, international growth company with nice colleagues. You will have the opportunity to work at a company with an inspiring and coaching way of leading that challenges traditional ways of working in the consulting service business. A strong network of contacts as well as extensive experience from various industries await you, giving you a unique opportunity to develop yourself further. You will gain rapid personal development in value-adding sales through coaching, training and exchange of experience.We are an open organization with a flat hierarchy. Whats more, we are an organization in transition to find new ways to do things better, bringing value and efficiency to our customers.You will report to the Software and Embedded Solutions Finland Sales Director and be a part of the global sales team.At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. description: **About the Role**We are looking for a **Financial Controller** to join our finance team in Tampere. This is a full-time, permanent position.In this role, you will be at the center of our revenue, fixed asset and working capital processes, working closely with our local Financial Manager, our global accounting team and both local and global colleagues across Sales, Supply Chain and Procurement.With us you will learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company working in an interesting field.**Location:** Tampere, onsite**Key responsibilities**- Coordinate sales invoicing and accounts receivable. Making sure invoices are accurate, follow up on payment terms and advance payments, and support collections. - Ensure correct revenue recognition and cut-off, reconcile sales revenue, and prepare sales-related accruals and provisions. - Maintain the fixed asset register for tangible and intangible assets, including additions, disposals, write-offs, transfers and depreciation plans. - Work with the Financial Manager on capitalization decisions, assets under construction, capitalized development costs and impairment testing. - Monitor capital expenditure against budget and run physical fixed asset counts and controls. - Prepare financial reporting, payment claims and audit documentation for publicly funded projects, including cost eligibility checks and personnel cost calculations, together with project managers and auditors. - Monitor and report on net working capital, especially inventory, together with Sales, Supply Chain and Procurement. Spot improvement opportunities and escalate them where needed. - Support the purchase process by developing the process flow, monitoring payments and maintaining the purchase approval tool. - Contribute to month-end and year-end closing, including reconciliations, and support our global accounting team. **What we require**To succeed in this role, you should have:- A degree in accounting, finance or business administration. - Around 3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience, including month-end and year-end closing. - Solid knowledge of Finnish accounting standards (FAS). Familiarity with IFRS, especially revenue recognition, fixed assets and impairment. - Experience with accounts receivable, revenue cut-off, accruals and reconciliations. - Understanding of fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation and assets under construction. - Experience with ERP systems (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central is an advantage). - An analytical, accurate and well-organized approach, with the ability to handle several deadlines at once. - Good communication and cooperation skills for working with Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, managers and auditors. - Fluent English and Finnish language skills. **What we see as a plus**- Experience in international / multi-entity structures **What We Offer****Paid Time Off**You are entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the start **Health & Wellness Package**- Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the tax-free limit as a fringe benefit. - Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies. - Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage and other wellness support. - Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care. - Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time. - Business Travel Insurance: coverage for work-related travel. - Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks. **Work Model**- Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00. - No-Crunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed. - Meeting-Light Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings. **Growth & Innovation**- High-End Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals. **Travel & Mobility**- Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation. - Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum tax-free Vero rates. **Impact & Culture**- Low-hierarchy, engineering-driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement. **Culture Statement**Don't meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us.Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology.**Some questions?**If there is something in your mind, you can send your question to careers\_finland@sineeng.com. Please note that we don't accept applications via email.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
description: Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa Touhula Merikarttaan, Joensuuhun.Meille touhulalaisille lapset ja perheet ovat sydämen asia. Yhdessä heidän kanssaan luomme onnellista lapsuutta ja hyvää työelämää – sitä rakastetuinta päiväkotia, joka on meidän kaikkien yhteinen.Uskomme, että varhaiskasvatus on yksi yhteiskuntamme tärkeimmistä asiantuntijatehtävistä. Haluamme kohdata jokaisen päiväkotimme ovesta sisään astuvan lapsen, huoltajan ja työkaverin lämpimästi, arvostavasti ja ammattitaidolla. Etsimme joukkoomme lapsuuden ja leikin puolustajaa, joka haluaa olla mukana rakentamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta ja johtamassa pedagogista toimintaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.Touhula Merikartta – millainen päiväkoti?Touhula Merikartta on neliryhmäinen päiväkoti, jossa uskomme jatkuvaan kehittymiseen ja rohkeuteen tehdä asioita entistä paremmin. Viime vuosien aikana olemme kehittäneet toimintaamme määrätietoisesti, ja tämä näkyy niin asiakastyytyväisyydessä, arjen sujuvuudessa kuin työyhteisön vahvistumisessa. Meillä lapset osallistuvat toiminnan suunnitteluun, pedagogiikkaa rakennetaan yhdessä ja uusia ideoita kokeillaan ennakkoluulottomasti.Etsimme joukkoomme ammattilaista, joka haluaa olla osa tätä kehitystä. Toivomme sinulta aktiivista ja omatoimista työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä aitoa halua kehittää toimintaa yhdessä työyhteisön kanssa. Arvostamme erityisesti osaamista tai kiinnostusta liikunta-, musiikki- ja kädentaitokasvatukseen sekä ymmärrystä lasten yksilöllisistä tuen tarpeista. Meillä menestyy henkilö, joka tarttuu toimeen, suhtautuu muutoksiin myönteisesti ja tuo työyhteisöön myös huumoria ja positiivista energiaa.Merikartassa pääset osaksi uudistunutta ja sopivan kokoista työyhteisöä, jossa ihmiset tuntevat toisensa ja yhteistyö on luontevaa. Käytössämme ovat Pedapuun materiaalit pedagogisen työn tukena, ja lähiympäristö tarjoaa monipuoliset mahdollisuudet retkiin, tutkimiseen ja toiminnalliseen oppimiseen. Haluamme vahvistaa erityisesti osaamisen jakamista, pedagogista kehittämistä ja yhdessä oppimisen kulttuuria, jossa jokainen työntekijä voi vaikuttaa päiväkodin tulevaisuuteen.Perheiltä saamme kiitosta lämminhenkisestä henkilöstöstä, monipuolisesta toiminnasta ja tavasta huomioida lapset osana arkea. Jos etsit työyhteisöä, jossa kehitystä tehdään määrätietoisesti mutta hyvässä hengessä, Touhula Merikartta voi olla juuri oikea paikka seuraavalle urastepillesi!Tehtäväsi varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana:Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tiimisi pedagoginen vetäjä ja innostava mahdollistaja. Vastaat ryhmäsi toiminnan suunnittelusta ja laadukkaasta vasuprosessista Touhulan pedagogista vuosisuunnitelmaa, Touhula Rytmiä hyödyntäen. Tehtäväsi ytimessä on:- Pedagoginen johtaminen: Vastaat tiimisi arjen pedagogiikasta, pienryhmätoiminnasta sekä monipuolisten ja turvallisten oppimisympäristöjen rakentamisesta.- Yksilöllinen tuki: Suunnittelet ja arvioit lasten tukitoimia yhteistyössä moniammatillisten verkostojen kanssa.- Asiakaskokemus: Vastaat tiimisi laadukkaasta asiakasviestinnästä ja luot myönteistä tunneilmapiiriä, joka välittyy perheille asti.- Tiimin tuki: Kehität osallistavaa palautekulttuuria ja tuet kollegoita pedagogisessa työssä tiimin vahvuuksia hyödyntäen.Me huolehdimme sinusta:Vastineeksi tarjoamme työyhteisön, jossa saat kasvaa ammattilaisena, oppia uutta, hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi ja vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Olitpa urasi alussa tai jo kokenut osaaja, teemme töitä sen eteen, että Touhula on sinulle paras paikka tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten tulevaisuuden hyväksi. Tarjoamme sinulle muun muassa:- Työterveyshuollon Pihlajalinnassa- Epassi-edun (200 €/vuosi)- Työhyvinvointirahan yhteisiä virkistys- ja tyhypäiviä varten (80 €/vuosi)- Kattavan perehdytyksen- laadukkaat pedagogiset työvälineet- Monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet ja täydennyskoulutusstipendit- Kannustavan ja kokeilunhaluisen toimintakulttuuriin, jossa sinä pääset ideoillasi vaikuttamaanTarjoamme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajalle kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka kokoaikaisella työntekijällä sijoittuu välille 2 792,02 – 3 293,23 €/kk. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy työkokemusvuosien sekä mahdollisen erityisosaamiseen perustuvan henkilökohtaisen palkanlisän mukaan. Voimme haastattelutilanteessa keskustella erityisosaamisesi huomioimisesta ja palkan tarkemmasta sijoittumisesta palkkahaitariin.Odotamme sinulta:- Kykyä rakentaa avointa ja ammatillista vuorovaikutusta kaikkien sidosryhmien kanssa- Vastuullista työotetta ja uskallusta kokeilla uusia toimintatapoja- Lain mukaista rikosrekisteriotetta sekä tartuntatautilain mukaista selvitystä- Varhaiskasvatuslain mukaista varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuuttaHuomioimme tarvittaessa myös varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaopiskelijat. Oppimisen ilo on meille tärkeää – siksi tuemme sinua opettajaksi pätevöitymisessä palkallisilla opiskelupäivillä ja 1000 euron stipendillä kannustinohjelmassamme.Haluatko tietää lisää? Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä!Touhula MerikarttaPuhelin: +358103258604 Sähköposti: anna.hukka@touhula.fi

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
description: Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa Touhula Taikapolkuun, Varkauteen.Meille touhulalaisille lapset ja perheet ovat sydämen asia. Yhdessä heidän kanssaan luomme onnellista lapsuutta ja hyvää työelämää – sitä rakastetuinta päiväkotia, joka on meidän kaikkien yhteinen.Uskomme, että varhaiskasvatus on yksi yhteiskuntamme tärkeimmistä asiantuntijatehtävistä. Haluamme kohdata jokaisen päiväkotimme ovesta sisään astuvan lapsen, huoltajan ja työkaverin lämpimästi, arvostavasti ja ammattitaidolla. Etsimme joukkoomme lapsuuden ja leikin puolustajaa, joka haluaa olla mukana rakentamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta ja johtamassa pedagogista toimintaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.Touhula Taikapolku – millainen päiväkoti?Touhula Taikapolku on neliryhmäinen päiväkoti, jossa uskomme leikin, liikkumisen ja yhdessä oivaltamisen voimaan. Arjessamme näkyvät luonto, toiminnallinen oppiminen ja lasten osallisuus. Lähimetsät, retket ja ympäristön tutkiminen ovat luonteva osa toimintaamme, ja haluamme tarjota lapsille mahdollisuuksia oppia, ihmetellä ja onnistua monipuolisissa oppimisympäristöissä.Etsimme joukkoomme ammattilaista, joka tarttuu toimeen, kantaa vastuuta ja haluaa olla aktiivisesti kehittämässä varhaiskasvatuksen laatua. Arvostamme lapsilähtöistä ja pedagogisesti vahvaa työotetta sekä halua vahvistaa erityisesti liikunta- ja musiikkikasvatuksen näkyvyyttä osana lasten arkea. Toivomme sinulta myös erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja sekä aitoa innostusta yhteiseen kehittämiseen.Taikapolussa pääset osaksi sitoutunutta ja motivoitunutta työyhteisöä, jossa puhalletaan yhteen hiileen ja jossa jokaisen osaamiselle annetaan tilaa. Saat ympärillesi osaavat kollegat, mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa toiminnan kehittämiseen sekä turvallisen työympäristön, jossa ammatillista kasvua tuetaan. Haluamme vahvistaa toimintakulttuuria, jossa toiminnallinen oppiminen, leikki, luonto ja liikunta näkyvät entistä vahvemmin jokaisen lapsen arjessa.Perheiltä saamme kiitosta lämpimästä kohtaamisesta, monipuolisesta toiminnasta sekä retkistä ja ulkona oppimisesta. Jos innostut pedagogiikan kehittämisestä, luonnossa oppimisesta ja yhteisöllisestä tavasta tehdä varhaiskasvatusta, voit olla juuri etsimämme kollega.Tehtäväsi varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana:Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tiimisi pedagoginen vetäjä ja innostava mahdollistaja. Vastaat ryhmäsi toiminnan suunnittelusta ja laadukkaasta vasuprosessista Touhulan pedagogista vuosisuunnitelmaa, Touhula Rytmiä hyödyntäen. Tehtäväsi ytimessä on:- Pedagoginen johtaminen: Vastaat tiimisi arjen pedagogiikasta, pienryhmätoiminnasta sekä monipuolisten ja turvallisten oppimisympäristöjen rakentamisesta.- Yksilöllinen tuki: Suunnittelet ja arvioit lasten tukitoimia yhteistyössä moniammatillisten verkostojen kanssa.- Asiakaskokemus: Vastaat tiimisi laadukkaasta asiakasviestinnästä ja luot myönteistä tunneilmapiiriä, joka välittyy perheille asti.- Tiimin tuki: Kehität osallistavaa palautekulttuuria ja tuet kollegoita pedagogisessa työssä tiimin vahvuuksia hyödyntäen.Me huolehdimme sinusta:Vastineeksi tarjoamme työyhteisön, jossa saat kasvaa ammattilaisena, oppia uutta, hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi ja vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Olitpa urasi alussa tai jo kokenut osaaja, teemme töitä sen eteen, että Touhula on sinulle paras paikka tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten tulevaisuuden hyväksi. Tarjoamme sinulle muun muassa:- Työterveyshuollon Pihlajalinnassa- Epassi-edun (200 €/vuosi)- Työhyvinvointirahan yhteisiä virkistys- ja tyhypäiviä varten (80 €/vuosi)- Kattavan perehdytyksen- laadukkaat pedagogiset työvälineet- Monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet ja täydennyskoulutusstipendit- Kannustavan ja kokeilunhaluisen toimintakulttuuriin, jossa sinä pääset ideoillasi vaikuttamaanTarjoamme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajalle kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka kokoaikaisella työntekijällä sijoittuu välille 2 792,02 – 3 293,23 €/kk. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy työkokemusvuosien sekä mahdollisen erityisosaamiseen perustuvan henkilökohtaisen palkanlisän mukaan. Voimme haastattelutilanteessa keskustella erityisosaamisesi huomioimisesta ja palkan tarkemmasta sijoittumisesta palkkahaitariin.Odotamme sinulta:- Kykyä rakentaa avointa ja ammatillista vuorovaikutusta kaikkien sidosryhmien kanssa- Vastuullista työotetta ja uskallusta kokeilla uusia toimintatapoja- Lain mukaista rikosrekisteriotetta sekä tartuntatautilain mukaista selvitystä- Varhaiskasvatuslain mukaista varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuuttaHuomioimme tarvittaessa myös varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaopiskelijat. Oppimisen ilo on meille tärkeää – siksi tuemme sinua opettajaksi pätevöitymisessä palkallisilla opiskelupäivillä ja 1000 euron stipendillä kannustinohjelmassamme.Haluatko tietää lisää? Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä!Touhula TaikapolkuPuhelin: 010 325 8728 Sähköposti: satu.laitinen@touhula.fi
