title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
description: Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire. Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.   Notre ambition est claire : Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux. Le projet :Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités : - Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun - Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes - Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations - Faire monter les équipes en compétence - Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal - Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ; - Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ; - Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.  La mission :- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc. - veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.    Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.  Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment : - Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Participer à la conception du Master Plan. Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective. Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc. Vous devrez également :- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées. - justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique. - posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires. - Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain. - Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement. - Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes. - Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant. Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

technique (DAT, procédures d'exploitation, guides d'intégration pour les développeurs).    * Support niveau 3 et accompagnement des équipes de développement dans la sécurisation de leurs API et applications.DÉFIS MAJEURS DE LA MISSIONLe principal enjeu de cette mission réside dans l'industrialisation complète d'un composant critique en mode « Configuration as Code » sans interruption de title: Postdoc (f_m_x) – Hydraulic Stimulation for Enhanced Geothermal Systems (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For the EU-funded project UPLIFT in section4.3 Geoenergy (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/geoenergy/overview) (department 'Geosystems (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geosystems) '), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) – Geothermal Reservoir StimulationReference Number 11660UPLIFT (https://uplift-horizon.eu/) brings together key European Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS (https://www.geothermie.de/bibliothek/lexikon-der-geothermie/e/egs) ) industry and research institutions to demonstrate, at Czechia's leading energy research site RINGEN, how water-only multi-stage hydraulic shear stimulation treatments can be efficiently implemented in metamorphic basement rocks in Europe, while reducing technical, social, and environmental risks.A central focus is the development and application of adaptive stimulation designs that use real-time seismic and hydraulic data to improve treatment efficiency and safety. The project will also investigate micro-turbine drilling as an alternative to conventional perforation techniques to improve reservoir access. Laboratory experiments will assess the self-propping behaviour of European basement rocks and benchmark their stimulation response against acid- and proppant-based methods. Water-only and proppant-based stimulation treatments will also be compared at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory. In parallel, the project will develop high-fidelity, physics-based digital twins to guide stimulation design, alongside fast surrogate models to support real-time operational decision-making. The stimulation activities are supported by high-resolution, real-time seismic monitoring, conventional and adaptive traffic light systems, and social science research.As a postdoctoral researcher, you will play a central role in planning, supervising and analysing the adaptive multi-stage hydraulic stimulation treatments at the RINGEN EGS site in Litoměřice, Czechia. This position offers the opportunity to connect advanced research with field operations and contribute directly to developing efficient, safe geothermal stimulation technologies.Your responsibilities:- Co-lead the hydraulic stimulation and well test activities at the Litoměřice EGS site- Analyse stimulation and well test data to compare and understand the hydraulic and seismic response of metamorphic basement rock to different stimulation methods and injection protocols, including adaptive injection strategies- Contribute to detailed operational planning and the preparation of tender documents- Contribute to the techno-economic assessment of different stimulation methods and their implications for EGS development- Publish your findings in peer-reviewed journals and communicate them at scientific conferences and to non-scientific stakeholdersAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- A Master's degree (or equivalent) and a PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in reservoir/petroleum engineering, drilling/completion engineering, geophysics, geothermal energy, applied geosciences, or equivalent- Research or industry background in Enhanced Geothermal Systems, well stimulation or induced seismicity- Well test analysis- Proficiency in spoken and written EnglishDesirable Qualifications:- German or Czech language skills are useful, but not required- Strong motivation and creativity, combined with an independent, structured, reliable and results-oriented working attitude- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with interdisciplinary project partners, the scientific community, engineers, and non-technical stakeholdersStart date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 36 MonateSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d) (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
description: Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus)You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology.Why join us?- Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development.- Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations.- International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites.- Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.- Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.About us – in briefHeadquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%.Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.Your Role – What You'll OwnYou will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform.Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation.Your Responsibilities- Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites.- Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need.- Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites.- Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.- Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs.- Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues.- Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities.- Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned.What You BringWe are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations.Must-have – Essential RequirementsThe following skills and experience are essential for this position:Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure- Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage.- Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure.- Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management.Infrastructure Modernization- A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems.- Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations.- Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments.Identity & Access Management- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments.- Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls.Endpoint Management- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment.Resilience, Security & Monitoring- Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor.- Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation.Communication & Collaboration- Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations.- Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders.- Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage.- Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations.Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered.Nice-to-have – Additional ExperienceThe following skills are beneficial but not essential:- Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects.- Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods.- Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management.- Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers.- Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel.- Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub.- Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform.- Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP.- Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300.Your First 12 MonthsYour initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure:- Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure.- Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt.- Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required.- Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune.- Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency.- Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery.- Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.What We Offer- Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site.- Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience.- Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses.- Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security.- Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.- Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices.- Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group.Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus)Start date: As soon as possible⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-timeReady to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure?We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements.Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team.We look forward to hearing from you!

Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology.Why join us?- Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development.- Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations.- International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites.- Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.- Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.About us – in briefHeadquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%.Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.Your Role – What You'll OwnYou will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform.Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation.Your Responsibilities- Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites.- Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need.- Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites.- Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.- Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs.- Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues.- Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities.- Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned.What You BringWe are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations.Must-have – Essential RequirementsThe following skills and experience are essential for this position:Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure- Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage.- Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure.- Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management.Infrastructure Modernization- A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems.- Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations.- Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments.Identity & Access Management- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments.- Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls.Endpoint Management- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment.Resilience, Security & Monitoring- Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor.- Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation.Communication & Collaboration- Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations.- Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders.- Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage.- Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations.Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered.Nice-to-have – Additional ExperienceThe following skills are beneficial but not essential:- Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects.- Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods.- Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management.- Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers.- Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel.- Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub.- Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform.- Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP.- Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300.Your First 12 MonthsYour initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure:- Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure.- Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt.- Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required.- Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune.- Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency.- Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery.- Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.What We Offer- Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site.- Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience.- Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses.- Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security.- Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.- Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices.- Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group.Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus)Start date: As soon as possible⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-timeReady to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure?We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements.Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team.We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d)  in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring (Biologe/Biologin)
description: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic MonitoringSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Department of Genomic Biomonitoring at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01.02.2027:**Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring ****(Full-Time / Part-Time)**Location: FrankfurtEmployment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.Genetic diversity is a fundamental component of biodiversity, providing the evolutionary potential that allows species and populations to adapt to environmental change. Yet genetic diversity is declining and remains comparatively underrepresented in biodiversity monitoring and policy. At the Genomic Biomonitoring Lab at Senckenberg, we work to address that gap and are seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join us in that aim.The position will focus on how genetic diversity can be measured, monitored and incorporated into practical conservation. This spans from species-level applications to national and international biodiversity policy. The researcher will contribute to ongoing projects on endangered and threatened species where genomics is needed to support management or can be used for monitoring. At the international scale, there is scope to investigate how genetic diversity can be incorporated into global biodiversity frameworks and assessments.We are looking for a researcher who is excited to help shape this emerging research area. The postdoctoral researcher will have the opportunity to develop new research questions and projects under our shared research programme. We are particularly interested in candidates who combine deep scientific curiosity with a motivation to translate ideas into practical conservation impact. Experience working in conservation genetics or genomics is thus essential.Your tasks- Conduct high-quality research on conservation genomics, genetic monitoring and integration of genetic diversity into policy.- Develop and apply approaches for monitoring and protecting genetic diversity in wild populations in Germany and at focal international sites.- Work on connecting genetic diversity with national and international policy.- Collaborate with researchers, conservation organisations, and other stakeholders.- Publish findings in high-quality peer-reviewed journals and present results at international conferences.- Communicate research findings to non-academic audiences, including through policy briefs and communication with conservation managers, and policymakers.- Supervise BSc and/or MSc thesis students.- Help develop international funding proposals for genetic diversity protection and monitoring.Your profile- A PhD in population/conservation/evolutionary genomics or a related field.- At least one year of postdoctoral research experience.- Hands-on experience with genomic datasets.- Experience in conservation biology and biodiversity protection, including collaboration with conservation practitioners, managers, or policy makers.- A strong publication record appropriate to your career stage.Desirable skills- Excellent scientific writing and communication skills in English.- Experience or a strong interest in developing research proposals and securing third-party funding.- A collaborative, collegial and well-organised approach to research and teamwork.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.Senckenberg is certified under the audit berufundfamilie programme and is committed to promoting a better work-life balance.How to apply?Please upload your applicationelectronically as a single PDF by 05.12.2026, containing:- A letter of motivation (1-2 pages), including clear explanations about your interest in the position and an outline of how your experience fits the research programme.- CV and publication list.- PhD certificate.- Contact details for two academic refereesPlease upload your application by clicking on the "Apply Online" button in the bottom of this announcement. Applications via email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Deborah Leighat deborah.leigh@senckenberg.de

title: Senior Sales Manager BESS Germany & Central Europe
description: Company description:.Job description:          What you will do?   As Senior Sales Manager BESS – Germany & Central Europe, you will drive our growth by developing the German market, converting complex opportunities and building long-term customer and partner relationships. Reporting to the Head of Sales EU & International, you will work closely with Volvo Energy’s commercial and technical teams to: •    Build and convert the BESS pipeline in Germany, with responsibility for selected Central European markets.•    Execute account and market plans, delivering sales volume, profitability and pipeline-quality targets.•    Commercialize BESS solutions and services for Commercial & Industrial, EV charging and selected utility-scale applications.•    Take direct responsibility for originating, developing and closing complex BESS sales, from initial customer engagement through tendering, negotiation, contracting and delivery handover.•    Coordinate internal specialists and external partners to create competitive customer solutions.•    Shape customer offerings, business models, pricing, financing options, partnerships and commercial agreements.•    Build senior relationships with customers, developers, utilities and channel partners across the region.   Your future team Join a close-knit, international team building a new business within Volvo Group. We combine the pace, ownership and entrepreneurial mindset of a start-up with the reach, expertise and stability of a global organization. You will work across sales, sales engineering, product, operations, finance and legal in a culture of collaboration, trust, accountability and initiative.   This is how you day will look like as Senior Sales Manager BESS A typical day focuses on visiting customers, understanding their needs and challenges, and using your market knowledge and experience to identify opportunities and create value. You’ll discuss proposals, develop solutions together, and lead negotiations through to signed agreements. Alongside your customer work, you’ll help shape the business direction and bring colleagues together to turn ideas into action.        Who are you?   You are a commercially driven BESS professional who builds markets and trusted customer relationships, taking ownership from first contact to signed contract. You bring:  •    A proven track record of originating, developing and closing BESS sales or project opportunities in Commercial & Industrial, EV charging or utility-scale applications.•    Strong commercial understanding of BESS, supported by technical knowledge of grid connection, electrical infrastructure, system design, project development and contracting.•    Experience with German or DACH energy-market customers and procurement processes, including RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, tenders, negotiations and contract award.•    Understanding of BESS business models and value streams, including ancillary services, energy arbitrage, peak shaving, flexibility and revenue stacking.•    Professional fluency in German and English, with the ability to lead commercial and technical discussions in both languages.•    A relevant university degree—or equivalent professional experience—in energy, engineering, business or commercial management.•    Strong commercial judgement, drive and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage several opportunities and travel regularly within Germany and Central Europe.     What’s in it for you?   Help shape sustainable energy solutions while developing your career in an international environment. We offer:   •    An attractive package with fixed salary and performance-related variable compensation.•    A company car under the applicable company car policy.•    Mobile working in line with company policy and business requirements.•    Autonomy to shape our BESS business in Germany and Central Europe.•    International collaboration and development opportunities across Volvo Group.   Location and working model: Based at Volvo Group Trucks Central Europe GmbH in Ismaning, near Munich, with mobile working in line with company policy and business requirements.       Ready for the next move?   Ready to help shape Volvo Energy’s BESS business in Germany and Central Europe? We would be pleased to hear from you.We value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you are motivated by creating customer value and contributing to the energy transition—even if your experience does not cover every area listed.    Feel free to contact me if you have further questions    Hiring Manager: Belén Neira, Head of Sales EU & International  Preferred start date: January 2027Application deadline: 3 December 2026   We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.   As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.    We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

The role combines quality assurance, technical documentation, repair assessment and coordination with specialist stakeholders.- Take on the responsibilities of Component Certifying Staff Part 145 under the applicable maintenance organisation approval.- Ensure that the quality management system complies with internal requirements and external regulatory standards.- Analyse existing processes, identify improvement potential and contribute to sustainable process optimisation within the repair station.- Create, update and manage quality-related documents, guidelines, work instructions and other technical documentation.- Advise specialist departments on the practical application and interpretation of quality requirements and procedures.- Plan and conduct quality awareness measures and training activities relating to quality management and quality assurance.- Contribute to internal and external audits, document findings and support the implementation of corrective actions through structured audit management.- Provide technical guidance to inspectors, perform repair inspections and assess whether repair activities meet the applicable requirements.- Review available data, apply the relevant repair instructions and implement engineering requirements, including the assessment of airworthiness-related aspects.- Support material and component assessments through appropriate Material testing activities and issue airworthiness instructions where required.VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:The Quality Engineer (m/w/d) position is suited to a technically trained professional who combines analytical thinking with practical quality management experience. A structured approach, sound judgement and the ability to work confidently with documentation and regulatory requirements are essential.- Completed studies in engineering, aerospace or a comparable technical discipline, or a qualification at technician or specialist level.- More than two years of professional experience in aerospace, quality management or quality assurance is advantageous for this role.- Practical knowledge of process analysis, process optimisation and audit management, ideally in a regulated technical environment.- Experience with document creation, guideline maintenance and technical documentation, preferably with more than one year of relevant experience.- Understanding of repair inspection, airworthiness requirements and the assessment of technical data and repair instructions.- Knowledge of Material testing or comparable material and component assessment processes is beneficial.- Confident use of SAP and advanced application knowledge of Google Workspace.- Very good command of German and English, both at a level suitable for professional discussions and technical documentation.- Strong analytical skills, a methodical working style, personal initiative, reliability and effective teamwork.- Full-time employment with 35 hours per week.Benefits:The position offers a structured professional framework for contributing to quality-critical processes and expanding practical experience in a technically demanding environment.- Maximalverdienst according to the applicable compensation framework for the position.- Structured onboarding to support a clear and systematic start in the role.- Corporate Benefits with access to participating employee discount offers.- Full-time working arrangement with 35 hours per week.- Opportunity to work on quality management, quality assurance and compliance-related topics with direct relevance to repair and support processes.- Professional exposure to audit activities, technical documentation, repair assessment and airworthiness-related responsibilities.

title: Customer order manager (m/w/d) AIRBUS (Customer-Experience-Manager/in)
description: As a Customer order manager (m/w/d) in Hamburg, you will coordinate repair, lease and exchange orders for proprietary aircraft components and serve as a central contact for international customers, repair stations and internal interfaces. The role combines customer order management, supply chain coordination, process control and performance monitoring across the complete order lifecycle.- Manage repair, lease and exchange orders, including order conversion and end-to-end order processing from the repair station through to the customer.- Act as the central contact for airlines, maintenance, repair and overhaul organisations, suppliers and repair stations regarding order status, commercial matters and aircraft-on-ground enquiries.- Monitor supplier and repair station performance against contractual obligations, agreed key performance indicators, delivery times, costs and quality targets.- Coordinate daily communication with repair stations to ensure reliable progress for open orders and timely transfer of piece parts required for individual repairs.- Analyse customer-specific problems, complaints and delivery risks, then coordinate suitable solutions with internal departments and external partners throughout the supply chain.- Provide customers with accurate and timely updates on component repairs, alternative service solutions, expected completion dates and relevant process changes.- Support purchasing, sales processing, material process management, demand planning and cost control for proprietary parts.- Prepare performance reports covering new, closed and open claims, shop processing time, turnaround time and action trackers, while contributing to projects focused on process improvement and future ways of working.VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:- A completed bachelor's degree or comparable qualification in industrial engineering, business administration, business economics, economics or a related field.- Practical experience in disposition, material procurement, customer service, customer care, supplier management or order fulfilment; experience in several of these areas is advantageous.- Knowledge of project management and process improvement, with the ability to coordinate actions across customers, suppliers, repair stations and internal departments.- Strong process control skills, including structured order tracking, demand planning, delivery monitoring, cost control and data analysis.- Confident use of Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office, including detailed functions for analysing order, performance and supply chain data.- Practical experience with SAP and collaborative digital work environments is beneficial for managing information and maintaining transparent process documentation.- Negotiation-level English for customer communication, stakeholder coordination and professional documentation; French, German or Spanish would be an advantage.- High customer orientation, responsiveness, intercultural understanding, resilience, personal responsibility and strong organisational skills.Benefits:- An unlimited employment contract- 35-hour workweek- 30 days of annual leave- An annual salary of around 72.000 €- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

title: Network Engineer / IT-Netzwerkspezialist (m/w/d) – WAN & Standortvernetzung (Netzwerkadministrator/in)
description: Du sorgst dafür, dass Unternehmen verbunden bleiben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass du den passenden Job findest.Ein Netzwerk ist für dich mehr als ein paar Switches, Router und blinkende LEDs? Du weißt, wie man Standorte zuverlässig miteinander verbindet, Netzwerkstrukturen optimiert und auch bei komplexen Herausforderungen den Überblick behält?Dann könnte diese Position genau dein nächster Karriereschritt sein!Für ein etabliertes, deutschlandweit tätiges Unternehmen mit einer vielseitigen IT-Landschaft suchen wir einen Network Engineer / IT-Netzwerkspezialisten (m/w/d), der die standortübergreifende Netzwerkinfrastruktur aktiv mitgestaltet und weiterentwickelt.Dich erwartet eine spannende Mischung aus Netzwerktechnik, modernen WAN-Technologien, Projektarbeit und der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Providern.Deine Aufgaben - Hier kommt dein Netzwerk-Know-how ins Spiel- Standorte verbinden: Du planst und realisierst WAN-Anbindungen für neue und bestehende Unternehmensstandorte und begleitest die Umsetzung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme.- Netzwerke weiterentwickeln: Du sorgst für eine stabile, sichere und leistungsfähige Vernetzung der Standorte und optimierst bestehende Netzwerkstrukturen.- Den gesamten Lifecycle begleiten: Ob neue Standorte, Erweiterungen, Bandbreiten-Upgrades, Providerwechsel oder Standortumzüge - strong governance for HR systems, integrations, data quality, security, reporting and analytics.- Enable workforce insights and data-driven decision-making through effective HR reporting and analytics.- Lead global change management, adoption and capability-building across HR, including AI fluency and digital ways of working.- Partner with HR, IT, Finance, Procurement and business leaders to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.- Build and lead a high-performing HR Technology and Digitalisation function, fostering innovation and continuous improvement.This is you:- You bring 10+ years of experience in HR Technology, Digital HR, HR Transformation or a related field within a large, complex global organisation.- You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (BSc/MSc) in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.- You have a proven track record of leading enterprise-scale HR technology transformations, including HR ecosystems.- You understand HR data, analytics, governance, security, privacy and compliance, and how these enable effective global HR services.- You are passionate about AI, automation and emerging technologies, with the ability to identify opportunities that improve HR efficiency and employee experience.- You can translate digital strategy into clear roadmaps, investment priorities and measurable business outcomes.- You are a strong change leader and communicator, able to influence senior HR, IT and business stakeholders across a global matrix organisation.- You combine strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, building strong teams, challenging legacy ways of working and driving digital adoption and continuous improvement.Why work for us?- lexible working arrangements title: Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d)
description: 1 Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d) Arbeitsort: SopronDarum dreht sich Ihre Rolle * Analyse, Vorbereitung und Konzeption ** Sie analysieren die bestehende Fertigung bei unserem bisherigen Lieferanten direkt vor Ort und dokumentieren die Abläufe lückenlos. ** Auf Basis der Daten setzen Sie das bestehende Fertigungskonzept konkret um und bringen sich aktiv in die Feinplanung sowie das Hallenlayout ein, um von Beginn an maximale Effizienz zu sichern. * Prototypenbau, Optimierung und Schnittstellenarbeit ** Sie koordinieren, steuern und unterstützen das Team beim Aufbau des Prototyps auf Basis des zugelieferten Bausatzes. ** Sie analysieren die Effizienz, vervollständigen notwendige Prozessdokumentationen im Dialog mit den Beteiligten und bauen ein System zur Qualitätssicherung in allen Fertigungsschritten auf. ** Sie geben technisches Feedback an das technische Büro zurück und arbeiten eng mit den zentralen Abteilungen (Technik und Projektleitung), der lokalen Geschäfts- und Werksleitung sowie den lokalen Meister:innen zusammen. * Serienüberführung, Arbeitsvorbereitung und Logistik ** Sie bereiten die AV vor, legen Losgrößen für Einzelteile fest und sichern die reibungslose Bereitstellung von Halbzeugen im Standardablauf des neuen Partners. ** Sie erstellen den Fertigungs- und Kapazitätsplan passgenau auf Basis unserer Bestellungen und Liefertermine. ** Sie überführen den Prototypen erfolgreich in die Serienfertigung und wirken parallel an der Entwicklung neuer Prototypen mit. ** Sie tragen die Verantwortung dafür, dass das Endprodukt nach unseren vorgegebenen Standards verpackt und transportiert wird. ** Sie führen und motivieren Ihr Team von 4-10 Personen mit klarem Blick für das gemeinsame Ziel.Diese Kenntnisse können Sie verwerten * Sie verfügen über einen Meistertitel in einem metallverarbeitenden Beruf oder einen HTL-Abschluss mit Matura. Zudem bringen Sie solide handwerkliche Erfahrung und idealerweise bereits Einblicke in die Arbeitsvorbereitung mit. * Sie bringen idealerweise fundierte Praxis aus dem Stahlbau oder der Fertigungstechnologie mit. * Sie haben nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Fertigung komplexer technischer Vorrichtungen sowie in der Serienfertigung. * Sie zeichnen sich durch eine hohe Detailorientierung aus, bringen Ideen konsequent auf die Straße und lassen sich auch von engen Zeitplänen nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. * Da Sie viele Schnittstellen koordinieren, überzeugen Sie durch ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, diplomatisches Geschick und die Fähigkeit, gemeinsame Lösungen zu finden. * Sie haben bereits erste Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeiter:innen gesammelt und verstehen es, Ihr Team zu motivieren und zu inspirieren. * Kenntnisse über Arbeitssicherheit und Arbeitnehmer:innenschutz im modernen Fertigungsumfeld sind für Sie selbstverständlich. * Sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich. Da sich die Fertigung vor Ort befinden, sind ungarische Sprachkenntnisse kein Muss, aber ein willkommener Bonus, um die Kommunikation vor Ort noch reibungsloser zu gestalten.Dieses Angebot bereiten wir für Sie vor * Eine abwechslungsreiche Position in einem internationalen Unternehmen, in einem interessanten, rasch wachsenden und innovativen Bereich * Ein engagiertes und dynamisches Team * Firmen-Events * Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg * flexible ArbeitszeitenJe nach Qualifikation und Vorerfahrung liegt das Grundgehalt bei dieser Position zwischen EUR 5.000,-- und EUR 6.000,-- brutto monatlich.Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie die Zukunft gemeinsam mit uns!Das AMS Baden wurde durch den Betrieb mit der Vorauswahl betraut.Bitte senden Sie Ihre aussagekräftigen schriftlichen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit folgenden Angaben in der Betreffzeile*U03-17423824*vorzugsweise per Mail an: bewerbung.baden@ams.atBei Mailbewerbungen Speichergröße von 3MB nicht überschreiten!bzw. per Post anAMS Baden * Service für Unternehmen *Nicole Vordre...

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Fenris Creations is looking for a Senior Software Engineer!The infrastructure team owns the core platform that powers EVE Online, building a reliable foundation that will scale and grow with our players over time. As a senior engineer on the team, you’ll own large, open-ended projects, such as making login faster and safer, letting a node fail without ending a fleet engagement, or finding where the latency in an RPC path goes. You’ll define the problem, propose a direction, split the work into pieces that each ship something useful, and build them with the team, supporting our most critical workloads.Your Tasks:Take a goal like “improve authentication”, talk to the people it affects, and write a design that breaks it into milestones.Lay out the tradeoffs (reliability, cost, effort, risk) and bring the team and stakeholders to an agreement.Write production code, mostly in Go, from service interfaces and data models to the messaging between services, and take your design through review to launch.Estimate throughput, storage and latency before you build, then load test and failure test the result.Work out how state is partitioned, replicated and cached, so a bad node degrades one region while the rest of the cluster keeps running.Explain your designs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders, review other people’s work, and mentor.Your Profile:You push clean, tested code in at least one language, such as Go, Python, Rust, Java, C++, C# or TypeScript. We write mostly in Go and expect you to pick it up quickly if you don’t know it.You break large, ambiguous problems into smaller ones and work through them systematically.You can design a system end to end, with realistic estimates for each component, and explain the tradeoffs.You know data structures and complexity, concurrency, how data stores behave as they grow, and why networks and services fail.You’ve led a project from a fuzzy idea to a shipped result, delivering in increments.You use excellent written and spoken communication skills to communicate and influence technical choices clearly, tailoring trade-offs for each audience.You measure what you build and use the data to choose what comes next.You may lean toward software design or toward how systems fit together, but a blend of both is the perfect sweet spot.Nice to have:Prior hands-on experience with distributed systems patterns: RPC, pub/sub, message queues, event streaming, replication, partitioning.Prior experience running services on AWS, Azure or Kubernetes.Prior exposure to tracing, metrics and structured logging (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus or similar).Philosophical inclinations towards infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible or similar).Prior experience with enough UNIX and networking (TCP/IP, load balancing) to debug your own systems.A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.What We Can Offer You:The inspiring opportunity of working on the award winning MMO EVE Online in cooperation with amazingly talented and passionate co-workers.A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.Double work station setup and flexible work environment.A lively fun division that hosts regular events.An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.Home internet.A conditional monthly transportation grant.Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.Relocation Package.Please submit your application in English: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/5d2d81e1-174f-4d78-b0cb-ff3a6bd24b4eApplication deadline: Deceember 31st, 2026

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Ræstingar ofl.
description: Leitað er eftir starfsmanni í hlutastarf við Orlofsbyggðina á Illugastöðum í Fnjóskadal. Starfið felst aðallega í þrifum á orlofshúsum á staðnum sem og afleysingum við þau störf sem til falla hjá Orlofsbyggðinni einnig getur verið um að ræða fullt starf yfir sumartímann. Engrar sérstakrar menntunar er krafist en hæfni og reynsla á þrifum er skilyrði. Ensku kunnátta og lágmarks íslensku kunnátta þarf að vera til staðar. Starfshlutfall getur verið misjafnt á milli mánaða en vinnutími er kl. 9 - 17 þá daga sem unnið er en vinnutími getur þó verið sveigjanlegur upp að vissu marki sé það ósk starfsmanns. Laun eru greidd skv. tímaskráningu hvers mánaðar miðað við launataxta SGS við SA. Starfsmaður þarf almennt ekki að sjá um sig sjálfur til og frá vinnu svo ekki er skilyrði að viðkomandi hafi örkuréttindi eða eigin bíl til umráða en það er vissulega mikill kostur. Ef upp kemur sú staða að starfsmaður komi á eigin vegum / eigin bíl er greiddur akstursstyrkur sem og gjaldið í Vaðlaheiðargöng er greitt fyrir viðkomandi.

title: Skipstjóri í hvalaskoðun
description: Skipstjórar og vélstjórar óskast.Norðursigling leitar að öflugum og ábyrgum skipstjórum og vélstjórum til starfa í hjarta hvalaskoðunar á Íslandi. Húsavík er þekkt um allan heim fyrir einstaka hvalaskoðun, stórbrotna náttúru og öflugt samfélag fólks sem elskar sjóinn og dýralífið.Við rekum einn fjölbreyttasta flota landsins, þar á meðal hefðbundna íslenska eikarbáta af mismunandi stærðum, seglskútur og RIB báta.Norðursigling býður:✅ Alþjóðlegan og samheldinn starfsmannahóp✅ Tækifæri til að sigla fallegum sögulegum skipum✅ Nánd við náttúruna og dagleg kynni af hvölum✅ Samkeppnishæf kjör✅ Húsnæði fyrir þá sem þurfaUmsækjendur þurfa að geta fengið samþykki frá Samgöngustofu til starfa á íslenskum farþegaskipum. title: Driller
description: Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members. Currently, we are seeking skilled assistant driller to join our team for a long-term geothermal drilling projects.Position Overview:As a driller, you will be responsible for operating and supervising the drilling operations on the rig. Your expertise will be critical to maintaining the smooth operation of the drilling process and ensuring that all objectives are met.Key Responsibilities:• Operate drilling equipment and supervise the drilling crew to ensure efficient and safe operations.• Ensure the maintenance and proper functioning of drilling equipment and tools.• Monitor drilling parameters and adjust operations to optimize drilling performance.• Ensure adherence to safety protocols, maintaining a focus on the well-being of the crew and compliance with industry standards.• Provide training, guidance, and leadership to junior crew members.• Communicate effectively with the Tool Pusher, engineers, and other staff to assess drilling progress and resolve any issues.• Maintain detailed records of drilling operations and report progress to management.• Manage equipment and materials to ensure smooth operations and prevent delays.Qualifications and Requirements:• Minimum of 5 years’ drilling experience as a Driller in geothermal drilling.• Experience with Drillmec rigs and/or Bentec Euro Rig 350 is highly preferred.• Current IWCF Well Control Certificate Level 3 or higher is required.• Strong communication skills and fluency in English.• Forklift license for 10 tons +• Excellent organizational, planning, and leadership abilities.• Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standards.Employer can assist with housingFull time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.Please send your CV and application to the following email: jons@jardboranir.isLast application date is December 31st, 2026.

title: Technical Director
description: CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience. In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. The ideal candidate brings deep game engine expertise across both runtime and tooling, experience in rendering and graphics, a practical belief in AI-assisted development, and a view of open source as both a near-term execution priority and a long-term strategic advantage.Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.Your Tasks:Define and drive the technical direction for CARBON across runtime, graphics, rendering, tools, pipelines, and shared developer technology.Collaborate closely with the Senior Development Director of Core Technology to translate product vision and priorities into clear technical strategy and execution.Lead and develop technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, strengthening quality, alignment, and team growth.Provide architectural guidance across CARBON, ensuring great decisions around performance, scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.Guide the department in adopting AI-assisted development in practical, high-value ways that improve speed, iteration, and engineering effectiveness.Shape CARBON's open-source direction to increase platform leverage, accessibility, and long-term relevance.Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities across the organization. Your Profile:Significant senior technical leadership experience in game development.Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.Proven ability to define technical direction and align multiple teams around a coherent engineering vision.People leadership experience across senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers.Conviction in the value of AI-assisted and open-source development, with the judgment to apply both strategically and practically.A pragmatic, growth-oriented leadership style with a bias toward learning, experimentation, and solution-finding within real-world constraints.Experienced enough as an engineer to lead with credibility through technical judgment, architecture, and code review.Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Please apply on our website: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/d2a51a4a-7510-400a-b141-e3883b9e02bdLast application date is Desember 31st, 2026
