title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro Cliente è un importante gruppo industriale italiano, leader nella manifattura per il settore food & beverage, con presenza internazionale e un percorso di sviluppo fondato su innovazione, investimenti e solidità operativa. Per potenziamento della funzione Acquisti tecnici a supporto dei plant, ricerchiamo un/una: Industrial Sr Buyer / Technical Procurement (CAPEX & MRO). La risorsa, riportando al Purchasing Manager, opererà trasversalmente sugli stabilimenti italiani con impatto diretto su continuità produttiva, governance della spesa tecnica e performance dei fornitori. Collaborerà quotidianamente con Engineering, Manutenzione e Plant Management, oltre che con Qualità/HSE, Finance e Legal. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. È possibile un contributo su iniziative corporate di standardizzazione/razionalizzazione con estensione internazionale. Principali responsabilità: Gestione end-to-end del sourcing su CAPEX, servizi tecnici e MRO: dal fabbisogno alla contrattualizzazione Impostazione e conduzione di RFQ/RFP e gare, con comparativi tecnico-economici e analisi TCO Negoziazione di condizioni commerciali e contratti (garanzie, penali, tempi di consegna, collaudi/accettazioni, ricambi e service) Definizione e gestione di accordi quadro e contratti di service con SLA/KPI, aumentando la copertura contrattuale della spesa ricorrente Vendor management: qualifica, monitoraggio performance, gestione criticità/claim, mitigazione rischi (lead time, single source, continuità assistenza) Supporto a Engineering/Manutenzione su standardizzazione, ricambistica critica e iniziative di miglioramento Competenze tecniche richieste: Diploma tecnico (Perito Meccanico/Meccatronico) e/o Laurea in Ingegneria (preferenza Meccanica/Meccatronica/Industriale) Esperienza indicativa 5-10+ anni in acquisti tecnico-industriali in contesti manifatturieri strutturati Esposizione concreta a CAPEX e contrattualistica service, oltre a categorie MRO (ricambi, consumabili, manutenzioni) Familiarità con tendering strutturato, logiche TCO e disciplina di processo Buona padronanza di ERP/strumenti di procurement Inglese fluente per negoziazione e gestione fornitori internazionali Competenze manageriali e soft skills: Negoziazione evoluta e capacità di gestire trade-off costo/qualità/rischio/continuità Autorevolezza con stakeholder tecnici, forte orientamento all'execution e gestione priorità in contesto produttivo Comunicazione sintetica e capacità di escalation strutturata Approccio data-driven, rigore e affidabilità Sede di lavoro: Italia, area Emilia-Romagna, con trasferte prevalentemente nazionali e, in funzione dei progetti, internazionali. Attività prevalentemente on site. Offerta: inserimento a tempo indeterminato. Package indicativo: RAL €45.000-€55.000 + MBO ~10%. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description: We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a3D Production Manager (m/f/d)Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmYOUR TASKS:- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters- Actively contributing to the further development of our companyYOUR PROFILE:- Experience in leadership- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness- Fluent English (business level)OUR TOP 3 REASONS:- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design- Responsibility right from the start- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international companyAfter an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.-------------------Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen3D Production Manager (m/w/d)Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmDEINE AUFGABEN:Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter WorkflowsAufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in HanoiÜberwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von ProzessenOrganisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen ZentraleAktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres UnternehmensDEIN PROFIL:FührungserfahrungErfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-WorkflowsErfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von VorteilFreude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter KommunikationHohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie ZuverlässigkeitStrukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte ArbeitsweiseHohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und DurchsetzungsstärkeFließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte UnternehmenskulturVerantwortung von Anfang anKurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen UnternehmenNach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description: The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineerRequired:-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)-German Endorsement for COC Master Course-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card-Excellent and fluent English language skills-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.Desired:- Previous SAR experience- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Rahoitusasiantuntija
description: **Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntija: vie yrityksen rahoitushanke itse alusta loppuun****Jokainen yritys ansaitsee rahoituksen, joka on rakennettu sen omaan tilanteeseen ja hankkeeseen.** Siihen tarvitaan ihminen, joka ymmärtää yrityksen tilanteen, ja työkalu, joka tekee valmistelusta nopeaa ja perusteltua.FSG Financial Services Group hakee **itsenäisiä yrittäjiä Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijoiksi**. Olemme rakentaneet uuden palvelumallin ja työkalun, jonka avulla et vain ohjaa asiakasta eteenpäin. **Viet rahoitushankkeen itse ensimmäisestä keskustelusta loppuun saakka.****Trusty Finance Broker** tuo asiakastyön, rahoitusanalyysin ja rahoittajille valmisteltavan aineiston samaan työympäristöön. Sinulle se tarkoittaa **vähemmän rutiinia ja enemmän aikaa asiakkaalle**. Voit hoitaa useampia rahoitushankkeita laadusta tinkimättä.**Trusty Finance Broker muuttaa rahoitusasiantuntijan arjen**Hyvä asiakaskeskustelu on vasta alku. Sen jälkeen yrityksen tilanne pitää jäsentää, rahoituksen perusteet arvioida ja aineisto valmistella. Trusty Finance Broker vie tämän työn kanssasi järjestelmällisesti maaliin.- **Asiakastyötila pitää kokonaisuuden käsissäsi.** Asiakkaat, rahoitushankkeet, sovitut asiat ja seuraavat askeleet ovat yhdessä näkymässä. Näet heti, missä kukin hanke on ja mitä tänään kannattaa tehdä. - **Trusty AI-Engine laskee, sinä tarkistat.** Se yhdistää sääntöpohjaisen laskennan ja tekoälyn. Se laskee tilinpäätöksistä ja tapaamistiedoista, millainen rahoitus hankkeelle sopii ja mihin takaisinmaksu perustuu. - **Asiakasraportti tekee tuloksista ymmärrettäviä.** Asiakas saa raportin päätöksenteon tueksi, ja sinä saat pohjan keskustelulle rahoituksen vaihtoehdoista. - **Rahoittajapaketti kokoaa valmistellun aineiston.** Siitä näkyy, mitä yritys aikoo toteuttaa ja miksi rahoitus kannattaa. Trusty Finance toimittaa sen niille rahoittajille, joille hanke sopii. - **Apua saat suoraan työympäristöstä.** Vaativassa tilanteessa pyydät FSG Financial Services Groupin tukea Ilmoita FSG:lle -toiminnolla. **Sinä tunnet asiakkaan, ja työkalu hoitaa laskennan, dokumentoinnin ja aineiston kokoamisen.** Yritys valitsee saamistaan rahoitustarjouksista itselleen parhaan.**FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia auttaa sinut alkuun ja pidemmälle****Rahoitusalan taustaa ei tarvita aloittamiseen.** Trusty Finance Brokeriin on rakennettu koulutusympäristö, FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia. Se opastaa työympäristön peruskäytöstä aina vaativiin yritysrahoituksen tilanteisiin.Opiskelet omaan tahtiisi, harjoittelet käytännön tilanteita ja osoitat osaamisesi osaamiskokeilla. Etenemisestä saat osaamismerkkejä. **Harjoituksia voit uusia rajattomasti.****Mitä teet Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijana?**- hankit yritysasiakkaita ja avaat keskustelun yrittäjien kanssa heidän hankkeistaan - kartoitat rahoitustarpeen ja kokoat tilinpäätös- ja tapaamistiedot - tarkistat rahoitusanalyysin ja käyt Asiakasraportin läpi asiakkaan kanssa - valmistelet Rahoittajapaketin ja huolehdit sovituista jatkotoimista - pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla hankkeen loppuun saakka **Roolin ydin ei ole tuotteiden myynti.** Ymmärrät asiakkaan tilanteen ja rakennat sille oikean rahoitusratkaisun. **Trusty Finance on yritykselle maksuton**, mikä madaltaa kynnystä aloittaa keskustelu.**Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**Voit tulla esimerkiksi B2B-myynnin, yritysasiakastyön, pankin, rahoituksen tai taloushallinnon parista. Kokemus yrittäjien kanssa toimimisesta antaa hyvän pohjan, mutta **tärkeintä on oikea ote**: kuuntelet asiakasta, haluat oppia ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun.Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos tartut oma-aloitteisesti uusiin asiakaskeskusteluihin, työskentelet huolellisesti ja haluat rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi pitkäjänteisesti.**Yhteistyömalli: toimit itsenäisenä yrittäjänä**Kyseessä on **yrittäjämalli, ei työsuhde**. Voit toimia oman yrityksen kautta tai kevytyrittäjänä, tai voit perustaa yrityksen aloituksen yhteydessä. **Yhteistyö edellyttää Y-tunnusta.** Voit hakea myös, jos olet valmis hankkimaan sen ennen aloittamista.**Ansainta perustuu toteutuneisiin rahoituksiin**Ansaitset provisiota toteutuneista rahoituksista. Aktiivisella tekemisellä ansaintatavoite on **noin 2 000–10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**, ja kokeneilla tekijöillä **yli 10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**. **Palkkiokattoa ei ole.**Kyse on yrittäjän provisiotulosta, ei kiinteästä palkasta eikä taatusta ansiosta. Ansainta riippuu toteutuneista rahoituksista, ja käteen jäävään tuloon vaikuttavat omat yrityskulut ja verot.**Mitä tarjoamme?**- **Trusty Finance Broker** -työympäristön koko asiakastyöhön - **FSG Trusty Finance Akatemian**, jossa osaamisesi kasvaa vaihe vaiheelta - **laajan suomalaisten ja pohjoismaisten rahoittajien verkoston** - oman trustyfinance.fi-sähköpostiosoitteen - perehdytyksen ja tuen perustajatiimiltä - mahdollisuuden edetä vaativampiin asiakassuhteisiin ja suurempiin rahoitushankkeisiin FSG Financial Services Groupin perustajatiimillä on yhteensä **yli 95 vuotta kokemusta** rahoituksesta, varainhoidosta ja teknologiasta. Tämä kokemus on tukenasi alusta alkaen.**Mitä tarvitset aloittaaksesi?**- oman tietokoneen, puhelimen ja internetyhteyden - sujuvan suomen kielen taidon ja ammattimaisen otteen asiakasviestintään - Y-tunnuksen tai valmiuden hankkia se ennen yhteistyön alkua **Hae Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijaksi**Haluatko ottaa vastuun koko rahoitushankkeesta ja rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi uuden työympäristön tuella? Kerro hakemuksessa taustastasi ja vahvuuksistasi sekä siitä, miksi yritysasiakkaiden auttaminen kiinnostaa sinua.Tutustu rekrytointiprosessiin ja lähetä hakemuksesi.Suora linkki hakemukseen: https://www.financialservicesgroup.fi/rekry/haku**Käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa nopeasti.**

title: IT Category Lead Buyer (m/f)
description: IT Category Lead BuyerLocations Luxembourgtime type Full timejob requisition id JR000777Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 470 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:‎ IT Category Lead BuyerYour roleReporting to the Central Procurement Manager, the IT Category Lead Buyer will be the primary procurement contact for an assigned portfolio of IT goods and services.The position combines category management with hands-on procurement execution. The IT Category Lead Buyer will work closely with IT service owners, Information Security, Legal, Finance, Accounts Payable and suppliers to ensure that purchases and renewals are commercially sound, appropriately approved, contractually covered and delivered on time.Your responsibilitiesSupport to Procurement strategy and sourcing for IT Category• Support strategy definition and deployment for assigned IT spend areas, including, as applicable, software, SaaS, hardware, maintenance, support, telecommunications and IT professional services• Analyse expenditure, supplier concentration, contract coverage, internal demand, renewal dates and purchasing patterns• Define the appropriate sourcing route for each requirement, such as competitive tender, quotation process, framework call-off, reseller competition or direct negotiation.• Prepare RFQs and RFPs, coordinate supplier responses, perform commercial comparisons and document procurement recommendations.• Monitor supplier-market developments and provide practical procurement guidance to IT stakeholdersContract renewals management• Maintain a reliable IT contract and renewal pipeline in the CLM platform , with clear milestones, responsibilities and escalation points.• undefined• Coordinate renewal activities between IT owners, suppliers, Legal, Finance, Data Protection and Information Security.• Ensure that required supplier due diligence, security assessments and internal validations are initiated and completed before purchase, renewal or contract signature.• undefined• Track contractual documentation, approvals, negotiation status, signature and purchase-order readiness.• undefined• Escalate late decisions, unresolved security findings, unacceptable supplier terms or potential service-interruption risks to the Central Procurement Manager and the appropriate IT owner. Operational purchase management• Ensure that purchase orders are issued before supplier delivery or invoicing, except where an authorised exception applies.• Confirm alignment among the purchase order, quotation, contract and approved budget.• Support compliance with procurement procedures, delegated authorities and approved buying channels.• Maintain complete and accurate procurement records in the relevant purchasing and contract-management systems.• Maintain clear trackers for sourcing initiatives, renewals, approvals, security reviews, contracts, purchase orders and invoice exceptions.• Assign actions and target dates to the relevant stakeholders and follow up consistently until closure.Procurement governance and performance management• Deploy Central Procurement policies, procedures, controls and standard templates across the assigned IT category.• Act as the procurement governance point of contact for IT owners, guiding stakeholders through the appropriate sourcing, approval, contracting and purchasing route• Promote the use of approved suppliers, framework agreements, standard contractual terms and consolidated buying channels across the IT category.• Monitor IT suppliers relationships and performance through business reviews, annual scorecards, collection of stakeholders feedback and follow-up of corrective action plansYour profile• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology or a related discipline.• 3–5 years of relevant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, contract management or purchasing operations.• Professional fluency in English and French• Practical exposure to IT procurement and existing IT suppliers network, preferably covering one or more of the following: software and SaaS; IT hardware; maintenance and support; telecommunications; cloud or hosting services; IT professional or managed services.• Good understanding of purchase-to-pay processes, including requisitions, approvals, purchase orders, goods or service receipt and invoice matching.• Ability to understand commercial IT models such as subscriptions, licences, maintenance, consumption-based services and professional-services engagements.• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spend, pricing, contract and purchasing data.• Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple renewals and operational priorities simultaneously.• Collaborative and service-oriented approach when working with IT, Finance, Legal, Information Security and business stakeholders.‎Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. Our professionals work with clients on engaging projects, empowered from the start. With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.Arendt promotes equal opportunities and value each employee for what they bring to the community. For more information, please refer to our diversity and inclusion policy on our website.Interested?If you are interested in this job opportunity, we are looking forward to receiving your application.All applications will be treated confidentially.Please be aware that the selected candidate will be required to provide a criminal record (or certificate of good conduct).

title: Production Manager (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:LUXUAV is an innovative technology company headquartered in Luxembourg, shaping next-generation airspace security for defence, civil, firefighting and police missions.We build a fully integrated Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) ecosystem that connects mission systems across ground, air, and stratosphere into one coherent governmental and commercial architecture.Job Title: Production ManagerReports to: Chief Operating OfficerRole overview:The Production Manager is responsible for leading the company's production operations, ensuring the safe, efficient and timely manufacture of high-quality unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The role manages the production team, oversees daily manufacturing activities, and works closely with Engineering, Industrialisation and Quality to deliver products that meet customer expectations, quality standards and business objectives.The Production Manager is accountable for production planning, workforce management, productivity, quality, continuous improvement and operational performance while fostering a positive and engaged team culture.Key ResponsibilitiesProduction Operations• Lead and manage all daily production activities to ensure safe, efficient andon-time delivery of products.• Develop and execute production schedules and targets.• Monitor production progress and adjust resources to meet changing priorities.• Ensure production targets are achieved while maintaining quality and safety standards.• Identify production bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve throughput.• Ensure effective utilisation of labour, equipment, and production resources.Team Leadership• Lead, coach, develop and motivate the production team.• Manage workforce planning, shift allocation and daily work assignments.• Manage performance and provide regular coaching and feedback.• Manage day-to-day employee relations issues within the production team, partnering with HR on formal or complex cases.• Identify training and development needs to enhance team capability.• Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.Quality• Ensure products are manufactured in accordance with quality requirements; and approved engineering drawings, specifications, Bills of Materials (BOMs) and work instructions developed by the R&D team.• Work closely with the Quality Manager to resolve production quality issues.• Promote a "right first time" approach throughout production.• Ensure production teams understand and comply with quality procedures.• Support non-conformance investigations and implement corrective actions.Production Planning & Performance• Ensure production plan is aligned to meet sales plan and/or customer delivery deadlines.• Ensure production plan and corresponding timely materials procurement requests are factored into the procurement plan.• Monitor production KPIs including output, efficiency, labour utilisation, schedule adherence, rework and productivity.• Analyse production performance and recommend improvements.• Prepare production reports for management.• Support capacity planning and future production growth.Health, Safety & Compliance• Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with health and safety requirements.• Ensure employees follow safe working practices and company procedures.• Participate in risk assessments and incident investigations.• Maintain a clean, organised and safe production environment.Continuous Improvement• Lead continuous improvement initiatives within production (e.g. 5S program implementation).• Improve production workflows, layouts and processes.• Reduce waste, rework and production downtime.• Support Lean manufacturing and other operational excellence initiatives.• Encourage employee suggestions for operational improvements.Inventory & Materials• Work closely with Supply Chain and Procurement to ensure material availability.• Monitor inventory accuracy within the production area.• Ensure appropriate handling and storage of components and finished products.• Minimise material waste and production losses.Cross-functional Collaboration• Collaborate with Engineering and Industrialisation to introduce new products into production.• Support prototype, pilot and low-rate initial production (LRIP) builds.• Provide manufacturing feedback to improve product design and manufacturability.• Support production readiness for new product introductions and engineering changes.Equipment & Facilities• Ensure production equipment is maintained and available.• Report equipment issues and coordinate maintenance activities.• Recommend investments in tools, equipment, and production capability.Qualifications & ExperienceMust have• Bachelor's degree or vocational qualification in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will also be considered.• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a manufacturing environment.• Previous experience leading production teams.• Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and production planning.• Understanding of quality management systems and manufacturing quality principles.• Familiarity with health and safety requirements within manufacturing.• Strong leadership and people management skills.• Excellent organisational and planning abilities.• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.• Good analytical skills with the ability to interpret production data.• Free criminal record no. 3Nice to have• Experience within electronics, aerospace, defence, automotive, or other high- technology manufacturing environments is advantageous.• Experience introducing new products into production is desirable.• Experience using ERP or manufacturing planning systems is advantageous.• National from a NATO member country or one of the following NATO Indo- Pacific partners: Australia, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand or Ukraine.

title: Director Global Marketing & Sales Enablement (m/f/d)

description: Description:Director Global Marketing & Sales Enablement (m/f/d)Id: 21688 Type: FullTime Location: Luxembourg Job DescriptionThe Director Global Marketing & Sales Enablement is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.Responsibilities:1. Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy• Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.• Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.• Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.• Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.• Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.2. Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement• Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.• Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.• Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.• Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.4. Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence• Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.• Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.• Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.• Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.Leadership & Experience• The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.• Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.• The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.Qualifications:• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset.• 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment.• Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.• Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.• Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. No agency or telephone inquiries please.Are you looking to join a world-class manufacturing organization? At Husky TechnologiesTM, we strive to be the best with a strong foundation built on innovation, collaboration and a unique culture with great people. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!What we offer• Excellent benefits package and retirement savings plans as well as life insurance program• Competitive vacation policy promoting work-life balance• Challenging career opportunities and growth • Opportunity to work, innovate and collaborate with passionate people who drive change• Amazing team – we are the best in the world at what we do!Husky TechnologiesTM Campus• Large, beautiful campus with clean, state-of-the-art air-conditioned offices and manufacturing facilities with high air quality, climate control and outstanding safety records• Onsite fitness and wellness center• Organized out- and indoor sports activities such as running teams, and bicycle teams• Access to onsite medical practitioners• Onsite cafeterias with fresh and healthy meal options• Free parking

title: Responsable Etudes (m/f)
description: Description du poste:Description de tâches :Le Responsable d'étude DAO Panels est chargé de la gestion quotidienne des études techniques des TGBT, tableaux secondaires, armoires de régulation HVAC et de leurs composants. Il assure la bonne exécution des plans transmis pour le projet auquel il est affecté.Le Responsable d'étude est rattaché directement à l'Engineering Manager.Il est le référent technique pour les TGBT, tableaux secondaires et armoires de régulation HVAC du projet dont il a la responsabilité.Il garantit la gestion du planning de remise des plans ainsi que la bonne réalisation des plans des différentes techniques du projet, dans le respect des délais, de la qualité et des consignes de sécurité.Il coordonne et assure le suivi de toutes les informations et données importantes auprès du Responsable d'étude, du Team Leader Design Office ou de l'Engineering Manager des projets qui lui sont attribués.Activités principales:➢ Concevoir et dessiner les schémas électriques des TGBT, tableaux secondaires, armoires de régulation HVAC et leurs composants sous EPLAN et AUTOCAD, en unifilaire et multifilaire.➢ Participer à la définition des schémas de câblage et de l'implantation en façade.➢ Réaliser les nomenclatures, formulaires, listes de matériel, borniers de raccordement et implantations des TGBT, tableaux secondaires et armoires de régulation HVAC pour les émissions initiales et les dossiers As Built.➢ Assurer la cohérence des schémas avec les cahiers des charges et les normes (sécurité, câblage, distribution électrique).➢ Collaborer avec les ingénieurs et chargés d'affaires afin de clarifier les points techniques et jalons du projet.➢ Veiller à la traçabilité et à la mise à jour des documents de référence.➢ Effectuer des contrôles qualité des livrables (vérification des schémas, cohérence des nomenclatures et listes de matériel, conformité aux normes, etc.).➢ Suivre l'état d'avancement des projets dont il a la charge, en respectant le planning.➢ S'assurer du bon fonctionnement du processus de validation des études et plans.➢ Gérer sa charge de travail.➢ Apporter un soutien technique et méthodologique à l'équipe projet.➢ Optimiser et fédérer le travail de l'équipe.➢ Assurer et rendre compte du suivi des études du projet à l'Engineering Manager.Organisation des ÉtudesPréparer, organiser, gérer, réaliser et informer l'équipe Engineering.RÉALISATION➢ Organiser, planifier et structurer la réalisation des études des TGBT, tableaux secondaires, armoires de régulation HVAC et leurs composants pour les projets qui lui sont attribués : analyse des bordereaux, élaboration du planning de remise des plans en collaboration avec l'Engineering Manager, examen des techniques spéciales CFO, réalisation des études, ordonnancement des plans unifilaires et multifilaires des TGBT, tableaux secondaires et armoires de régulation HVAC, ainsi que validation de leur réalisation.➢ Veiller au respect et à l'application des règles de Santé & Sécurité (ISO 45001) sur l'ensemble des projets.➢ Participer, en collaboration avec l'activité projets, aux réunions techniques, de coordination et du bureau d'études.➢ Organiser des réunions internes de suivi du projet avec l'Engineering Manager et l'Activity Manager Panels.➢ Assurer le suivi des approbations des plans, des retours chantier/projets et des rapports de réception du bureau de contrôle.Gestion économique du projetSuivre le budget étude du projet avec l'Engineering Manager.➢ Assurer le suivi des études supplémentaires auprès de son Engineering Manager et de l'équipe projet.➢ Veiller à la rentabilité du projet et être force de proposition pour des solutions techniques conformes et plus économiques.Relations internes➢ General Manager➢ Department Manager, Engineering Manager, Team Leader Design Office, Activity Manager et Project Manager➢ Équipes du département Engineering➢ Responsables des différents services transversaux➢ Équipes opérationnellesRelations externes➢ Clients➢ Bureaux d'études➢ Organismes de contrôleExigences du profil:➢ BAC+2 Technicien supérieur en électrotechnique.➢ Maîtrise des plans TGBT, tableaux secondaires et armoires de régulation HVAC.➢ Bonne connaissance des normes électriques en vigueur et des règles de sécurité.➢ Plusieurs années d'expérience dans le domaine.➢ Maîtrise approfondie d'EPLAN : création, édition et gestion de projets, composants et bibliothèques.➢ Bonne connaissance d'AUTOCAD pour la réalisation des schémas unifilaires et implantations TGBT.➢ Conception des schémas électriques, logiques et de câblage.➢ Élaboration de nomenclatures et listes de matériel.➢ Sens de l'organisation et capacité à prioriser les tâches.➢ Langue requise : français. La connaissance de l'allemand et/ou du luxembourgeois sera un avantage.Compétences requises➢ Capacité à diriger et dynamiser les équipes.➢ Organisé, autonome, réactif et rigoureux.➢ Capacité dans le management, le relationnel et la communication interne et externe de l'entreprise.➢ Esprit d'équipe.➢ Éthique et polyvalence.

title: SENIOR SCIENTIST IN AGENTIC AI FOR ENVIRONMENTAL DIGITAL TWINS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description: Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? LIST is looking for an experienced Senior Scientist to strengthen its capabilities in agentic artificial intelligence for geospatial and environmental applications, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs), scientific workflow orchestration and space-enabled environmental digital twins. The successful candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling (REMOTE) group, an interdisciplinary team combining Earth Observation (EO), environmental modelling, AI, data assimilation and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication networks. Our ambition is to turn cutting-edge AI and space-enabled technologies into solutions for disaster risk reduction, resilient agri-food systems, terrestrial ecosystem resilience, civil security and humanitarian action. The new colleague will contribute to ongoing RDI projects while progressively developing new methodologies, collaborations and research directions with the group's scientists. Building on REMOTE's established expertise in AI for Earth Observation, multimodal satellite-data analysis and environmental modelling, the successful candidate will bring complementary expertise in the design of reliable LLM-based agentic systems that can reason across EO datasets, scientific knowledge, models and services; plan and execute scientific workflows; verify results; and communicate uncertainties and findings transparently. Experience with vision-language models (VLMs) and geospatial foundation models would further strengthen multimodal and spatial reasoning. A central objective is to enable users to interact more intuitively with environmental digital twins: formulate questions in natural language, identify suitable observations and models, configure and run simulations, compare alternative scenarios, and receive scientifically grounded, interpretable answers. Illustrative “what-if” questions include:• Flood risk: How would altered precipitation patterns or proposed flood-protection measures affect inundation extent, water depth and the exposure of buildings in urban catchments? An agentic workflow could combine historical and near-real-time satellite observations, hydrological and hydraulic models, and alternative climate or adaptation scenarios to compare risk-reduction options.• Agriculture: How might prolonged drought, altered irrigation practices or a warmer growing season affect crop water stress and yield at field or regional scale? A digital twin could couple EO-derived soil moisture, crop water stress, land surface temperature and evapotranspiration with crop models, AI and data assimilation to compare management options. These examples illustrate the approach rather than prescribe a narrow project portfolio. The role is cross-cutting: the selected scientist will work with domain experts, build on existing digital twin activities in urban, coastal and agricultural systems, and explore synergies with distributed sensing, IoT and satellite-enabled connectivity. Awareness of the European digital-twin and data-space ecosystem will help position developments for interoperability and collaboration. Relevant initiatives include Destination Earth (DestinE), ESA Digital Twin Earth and EO Digital Twin Components, as well as EU-funded ecosystem and biodiversity digital-twin projects such as TerraTwin and BioDT. Complementary initiatives, including the European Green Deal Data Space and the Common European Agricultural Data Space, provide a framework for interoperable and trusted data sharing across stakeholders. The selected researcher will be mainly in charge of:• Designing and evaluating LLM-based, tool-using and multi-agent systems to orchestrate EO data access, geospatial processing, environmental models, simulations and digital-twin services.• Translating natural-language questions into traceable model configurations and executable workflows, with robust planning, verification, spatial/temporal reasoning, uncertainty handling and explainable outputs.• Contributing to ongoing interdisciplinary RDI projects and co-developing scalable, reproducible solutions with EO scientists, environmental modellers and infrastructure specialists.• Connecting AI workflows with cloud/HPC environments, research infrastructures and, where relevant, distributed sensing and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication systems, working with infrastructure specialists to support interoperable access to IoT sensor streams, satellite observations, weather data and model services across stakeholders, with appropriate data governance and traceability.• Initiating and leading new interdisciplinary research projects, partnerships and competitive proposals; supervising researchers; and disseminating and valorising results. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now! Education• PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Geoinformatics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related discipline. Experience and skills• Established scientific track record in AI, with demonstrated hands-on expertise in LLMs and agentic AI systems, including tool use, planning, orchestration and interaction with external APIs, data services or scientific models.• Strong understanding of modern foundation-model methods and development frameworks, such as retrieval-augmented generation, context engineering, multi-agent architectures and systematic model/agent evaluation.• Ability to design robust, reproducible computational workflows with appropriate validation, uncertainty assessment, traceability and interpretability; strong programming skills.• Working knowledge of EO/geospatial data and an aptitude for spatial and temporal reasoning; motivation to apply advanced AI to practical environmental and societal challenges.• Collaborative and interdisciplinary mindset, with the ability to contribute to ongoing research activities and leverage complementary expertise in Earth Observation, environmental sciences and modelling.• Demonstrated experience in scientific leadership, developing competitive research proposals, building national and international collaborations, supervising researchers and publishing high-quality scientific work. Language skills• Fluency in spoken and written English; French, German and/or Luxembourgish would be an asset. Your LIST benefits• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month [...]

title: Instructeur de natation“ (m/w/d) mit CATP / DAP und Meisterbrief
description: Die Stadtverwaltung Grevenmacher stellt für das städtische Freibad einen Arbeitsnehmer (m/w/d) mit manueller Tätigkeit im Beruf „instructeur de natation“ mit CATP / DAP ein.Arbeitsvertrag: unbefristet.Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%.Einstellung: ab März 2027Einstellungsbedingungen:–      Staatsangehöriger eines Mitgliedstaates der EU;–      Sprachkenntnisse in Luxemburgisch, Deutsch und Französisch;–      Besitz der zivilen und politischen Rechte;–      Führerschein der Klasse B;–      CATP / DAP im Beruf „instructeur de natation“ (oder ein vom Ministerium für Erziehung und Berufsausbildung als gleichwertig anerkanntes ausländisches Diplom)Der Kandidat muss im Besitz eines Meisterbriefes als geprüfter Meister für Bäderbetriebe sein. Des Weiteren wird Urlaubsanträgen während der Freibadsaison nur in Ausnahmefällen stattgegeben.Außerhalb der Freibadsaison sind die Arbeitszeiten von 7.00 Uhr bis 12.00 Uhr und von 13.00 Uhr bis 16.00 Uhr.Beizufügende Unterlagen:–      Bewerbungsschreiben;–      Ausführlicher Lebenslauf mit Foto;–      Kopie des CATP / DAP- Diploms / des Meisterbriefes;–      Geburtsurkunde (nicht älter als 2 Monate);–      Auszug aus dem Strafregister (nicht älter als 2 Monate)–      Passfoto–      Kopie eines Ausweisdokumentes;–      Kopie des Führerscheins.Unvollständige Bewerbungen werden nicht berücksichtigt Beschäftigungsbedingungen und Vergütung:Spätestens bei Dienstantritt muss der Kandidat die für die Ausübung seines Amtes erforderliche körperliche Eignung nachweisen. Dezember 2026 über die Plattform „Skeeled“ (www.grevenmacher.lu – Veröffentlichungen – Jobs) einzureichen. title: Directeur Général Adjoint (h/f/d)
description: Directeur Général Adjoint (H/F/D) CDI - Temps plein - Luxembourg (Strassen) Réf. : AeS/DGA Rejoignez l'Agence eSanté L'Agence eSanté, agence nationale des informations partagées dans le domaine de la santé, joue un rôle central dans la transformation numérique du système de santé luxembourgeois. Elle développe et opère les services qui permettent aux patients et aux professionnels de santé d'échanger et de partager les données de santé en toute sécurité : dossier de soins partagé, réseau sécurisé HealthNet, annuaires nationaux des patients et des professionnels, carnet de vaccination électronique, messagerie sécurisée, échanges transfrontaliers de données de santé, entre autres. Les années à venir sont décisives : la mise en oeuvre du règlement européen sur l'Espace européen des données de santé (EHDS) et le développement de la nouvelle génération du dossier de soins partagé s'accompagnent d'une forte croissance de l'Agence et de ses effectifs. L'Agence eSanté recrute un(e) Directeur Général Adjoint. Directement rattaché(e) au Directeur Général et membre du Comité de Direction, vous contribuez au pilotage et au développement de l'Agence. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les autres membres de la Direction, les différentes fonctions de l'Agence et ses instances de gouvernance, notamment le Président du Conseil de gérance. Votre mission En tant que Directeur Général Adjoint, vous accompagnez le Directeur Général dans la direction, le pilotage et le développement de l'Agence et contribuez à la mise en oeuvre de ses orientations stratégiques. Membre du Comité de Direction, vous participez à la gouvernance de l'Agence, préparez les décisions et arbitrages et accompagnez les transformations organisationnelles nécessaires à son développement. Vous pilotez les fonctions support de l'Agence (ressources humaines, finances, secrétariat, qualité et organisation, juridique, conformité, marchés publics, formation et formation continue, contrats ainsi que communication), veillez à la performance et à la cohérence des dispositifs transverses et représentez l'Agence dans le cadre des délégations qui vous sont confiées. Vos principales responsabilités • Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre des orientations stratégiques et au développement de l'Agence, en accompagnant le Directeur Général dans la définition des priorités et leur déclinaison opérationnelle, • Participer à la gouvernance de l'Agence, conseiller le Directeur Général, préparer les décisions et arbitrages soumis aux instances compétentes et veiller au suivi de leur mise en oeuvre, • Assurer le secrétariat du Conseil de gérance et de l'Assemblée générale : préparation des séances et des dossiers, rédaction des procès-verbaux et relevés de décisions, suivi de l'exécution des décisions, • Superviser les programmes et projets de transformation organisationnelle conduits pour le compte du Comité de Direction, en veillant à leur avancement, à leurs moyens et à la préparation des décisions nécessaires, • Piloter les fonctions placées sous votre responsabilité, garantir la cohérence de leurs activités et veiller à la disponibilité et à l'utilisation optimale des ressources de l'Agence, • Contribuer aux orientations budgétaires et financières et piloter la préparation, l'exécution et le suivi budgétaire annuel et pluriannuel dans le cadre des responsabilités déléguées, • Veiller à la cohérence des politiques, processus et dispositifs de gouvernance interne et superviser les dispositifs de contrôle et de conformité relevant de votre périmètre, dans le respect des responsabilités et de l'indépendance des fonctions compétentes, • Piloter la performance et la maîtrise des risques relevant de votre périmètre, en coordonnant les démarches d'audit, de certification et d'amélioration continue avec les fonctions compétentes, • Favoriser la coopération entre les fonctions et contribuer, aux côtés du Directeur Général, à la préparation et à la conduite du dialogue social, • Manager et développer les responsables placés sous votre autorité, renforcer leurs compétences managériales et promouvoir une culture de responsabilité, de coopération et de remontée précoce des difficultés, • Représenter l'Agence auprès des autorités et partenaires institutionnels dans le cadre de vos délégations et assurer la suppléance du Directeur Général conformément aux dispositions applicables. Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation supérieure de niveau Master ou équivalent en management, administration publique, économie, gestion, finances, droit, politiques publiques, ingénierie, gouvernance des organisations ou dans un domaine équivalent. Vous justifiez : • d'au moins 10 années d'expérience dans des fonctions de direction, de management senior ou de pilotage de fonctions support, • d'une expérience confirmée dans le management de managers et le pilotage de plusieurs fonctions support ou domaines de responsabilité transverses, • d'une expérience solide en gouvernance organisationnelle, en conseil à une Direction Générale et en préparation de décisions stratégiques, • d'une expérience dans le pilotage budgétaire et financier, la conduite de transformations organisationnelles et les relations avec des autorités ou partenaires institutionnels. Une expérience dans le secteur public, parapublic, de la santé ou dans un environnement fortement réglementé constitue un atout. Une bonne connaissance du secteur de la santé, de ses acteurs et de son environnement institutionnel et réglementaire, ou la capacité à l'acquérir rapidement, constitue également un atout. Compétences recherchées • Solide maîtrise des principes de gouvernance, des processus décisionnels et du pilotage stratégique d'une organisation, • Expérience confirmée dans la direction et la coordination de fonctions pluridisciplinaires et dans la gestion des ressources humaines, financières et organisationnelles, • Bonne maîtrise de la gestion budgétaire et financière, des marchés publics nationaux et européens, de la gestion contractuelle et des enjeux juridiques et réglementaires, • Maîtrise des dispositifs de pilotage de la performance, de contrôle interne, de gestion des risques et de conformité, • Capacité à conduire des transformations organisationnelles, à faire évoluer les processus et à accompagner le changement, • Leadership confirmé dans le management de managers, le développement des compétences et la mobilisation d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, • Bonne compréhension des environnements institutionnels et capacité à conseiller la Direction Générale, à préparer des arbitrages complexes et à représenter l'organisation auprès d'interlocuteurs de haut niveau, • Pratique avancée des outils numériques et de l'IA générative pour accroître votre efficacité et celle de vos équipes, dans le respect des exigences de sécurité et de confidentialité. Qualités personnelles • Leadership, sens des responsabilités et capacité à fédérer autour d'objectifs communs, • Vision stratégique, esprit d'analyse et capacité à prendre du recul, • Courage décisionnel, indépendance de jugement et capacité à assumer les arbitrages, • Diplomatie, sens de l'écoute et capacité à développer des relations de confiance, • Pragmatisme, orientation résultats et capacité à agir dans des situations complexes ou sensibles, • Exemplarité, intégrité, loyauté institutionnelle et engagement au service de l'intérêt général. title: Group Chief Compliance Officer (m/f)

Group Compliance Program • Design, implement, and continuously enhance the Group Compliance Program. • Establish common standards, policies, procedures, methodologies, and reporting frameworks across all entities. • Drive initiatives that improve effectiveness, scalability, efficiency, and consistency of compliance activities throughout the Group.3. The Group Compliance Function is intended to coordinate compliance risk oversight, support regulatory change implementation, and promote a culture of compliance and integrity throughout the Group. title: Manager, Client Corporate Governance (Luxembourg) (m/f)
description: Manager, Client Corporate Governance (Luxembourg)Role OverviewAs Manager, Client Corporate Governance (Luxembourg), you will be accountable for a team of governance professionals and a defined portfolio of clients. Reporting to the Jurisdiction Lead, you will combine hands-on client leadership with people management, portfolio oversight, commercial awareness and technical governance expertise.This is a core management role and an important development step towards broader jurisdictional leadership. You will make decisions within your portfolio, coach and develop team members, lead key client relationships, guide complex governance matters and contribute to the continued development of how ONE delivers governance services.At ONE, we believe talented people do their best work when given trust, autonomy and the freedom to make a genuine impact. We are looking for people who combine strong technical.Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities 1. Team Leadership & People Development • Lead, organise and develop a team of governance professionals responsible for an allocated client portfolio. • Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and create an environment in which team members are trusted, supported and accountable. • Coach and develop team members, building technical capability, professional judgement and confidence. • Create meaningful opportunities for colleagues to take on increasing responsibility and progress their careers. • Support engagement, retention and succession planning within the team. • Plan and allocate work effectively across the team, balancing client priorities, capacity and development opportunities. 2. Portfolio Delivery & Governance Leadership • Own the day-to-day delivery of Company Secretarial, Corporate Governance and Domiciliation Services across the allocated client portfolio, including accountability for technical quality, appropriate review and escalation. • Maintain high standards of quality, consistency and service across board support, minutes, resolutions, statutory maintenance and governance reporting. • Lead complex transactions, restructurings, incorporations, liquidations and governance projects within the portfolio. • Apply ONE governance standards and quality controls consistently across the team. • Use sound judgement to make portfolio decisions and provide technical guidance on complex governance matters, acting as a point of escalation for the team and ensuring material or higher-risk matters are escalated appropriately. 3. Client Relationship Management • Lead relationships with clients, boards and senior stakeholders across a varied portfolio of financial services and investment fund structures. • Build trusted relationships with AIFMs, management companies, banks, investment managers, sponsors, institutional investors and professional advisers, as relevant to the portfolio. • Provide practical governance advice and lead client service discussions. • Take ownership of complex client requirements and ensure agreed actions are delivered. • Support client retention and appropriate growth opportunities through high-quality service and strong relationships. 4. Risk, Compliance & Professional Standards • Maintain effective oversight of governance-related risks and controls across the portfolio. • Ensure governance activities are delivered in accordance with applicable requirements, constitutional documents and internal policies. • Stay abreast of regulatory and market developments and translate relevant changes into practical team actions. • Promote sound governance, professional conduct and ethical decision-making across the team. 5. Continuous Improvement & Change • Identify and implement practical improvements to governance delivery and the ONE operating model. • Lead standardisation, automation and efficiency initiatives within the team and portfolio. • Drive the responsible adoption and effective use of technology and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency and client outcomes, ensuring agreed tools and processes are embedded across the team. • Contribute operational insight to governance products, processes and service development. • Participate in jurisdictional and cross-business initiatives. 6. Portfolio & Commercial Management • Own portfolio planning, utilisation, time recording, recoverability, work in progress and invoicing discipline, taking timely action where performance falls outside expectations. • Provide relevant forecasting and portfolio information to the Jurisdiction Lead. • Contribute technical and delivery input to proposals, DDQs, client pitches, pricing reviews and scope discussions. • Identify and actively pursue opportunities to deepen client relationships and broaden appropriate services. • Manage the portfolio with appropriate attention to scope, efficiency, recoverability and sustainable service delivery, identifying and addressing scope creep, under-pricing and other issues affecting client economics. 7. Client Governance & Internal Collaboration • Attend board meetings and contribute independent judgement, challenge and governance expertise. • Support effective board decision-making, oversight and governance practices across assigned structures. • Build credibility as a trusted governance contact for boards and senior stakeholders. • Work closely with the Jurisdiction Lead and colleagues across Compliance, Risk, Finance, Technology and other service teams. • Support new business approvals, client onboarding and governance reviews for the portfolio. • Represent ONE professionally with clients, boards, advisers and external stakeholders. Profile & Experience • Degree educated with a strong academic background in law, corporate governance, business administration, corporate services or a related discipline. • Professional qualification in Corporate Governance, Company Secretarial Practice, Law, Compliance or similar highly desirable. • +7 years' relevant experience within company secretarial, governance, fund administration, fiduciary services or a related governance environment. • Demonstrable experience managing complex Luxembourg fund, corporate or regulated financial services structures. • Strong understanding of Luxembourg corporate law, governance requirements and regulated environments. • Experience across a broad range of financial services clients or structures, which may include UCITS, alternative investment funds, management companies, banks, investment managers and related corporate entities. • Demonstrable experience leading, supervising and developing governance professionals. • Experience owning a portfolio of clients and managing relationships with boards and senior stakeholders. • Experience improving delivery quality, standardising processes and implementing operational change. • Excellent communication skills and fluent written and spoken English. Additional European languages advantageous. Key Attributes • Strong commercial awareness and understanding of professional services delivery models. • Enjoy helping people and teams succeed. • Prefer creating solutions rather than simply following established processes. • Are comfortable making decisions and taking ownership. • Enjoy engaging with clients, boards and senior stakeholders. • Balance commercial awareness with sound judgement and governance integrity. • Are energised by growth, change and continuous improvement. • Believe technology should enhance, rather than replace, professional expertise.

description: Permanent contract | BelvauxAre you passionate about research? So are we! Research will investigate processes controlling behavior of Earth's Critical Zone, with an emphasis on understanding dependencies and feedbacks between the hydrologic cycle and ecosystems. We seek a scientist dedicated to integrating novel empirical observations and theory to answer questions motivated by pressing societal needs related to natural resources, and relevant to both the global scientific community and applied practitioners who manage those natural resources. Tracers of eco-hydrologic processes. Research developing and applying innovative tracer approaches to understand water dynamics and associated biogeochemical processes across the soil–plant–atmosphere continuum. Building on existing strengths and infrastructure in the group, particular interest lies in stable isotope approaches that integrate environmental and eco-hydrological information using hydrological, plant physiological, or biogeochemical measurements.2. Small-catchment eco-hydrology. Research investigating interactions among vegetation, water dynamics, and biogeochemical processes, especially in forested headwater catchments. title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Engineer (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:Job Description: Post-Quantum Cryptography EngineerPosition:  Post-Quantum Cryptography EngineerLocation:  Esch-sur-Alzette, LuxembourgStart Date:  ImmediateType:  Full-timeSalary:  Competitive, based on qualifications and experienceCompany OverviewLuxQuantum is a deep-tech startup developing quantum-safe security solutions. Our mission is to enable the transition to quantum-safe communications by integrating classical cryptography, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), and Quantum Key Distribution (QKD).Our current R&D efforts focus on the development of hybrid quantum security technologies, including cryptographic key combination, key management, and interoperability across heterogeneous communication infrastructures.We are looking for a motivated Post-Quantum Cryptography Engineer to join our growing team and contribute to the design, implementation, and validation of cryptographic components for hybrid quantum-safe communication systems.Role OverviewAs a Post-Quantum Cryptography Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of hybrid quantum-safe communication solutions. The role focuses on the design, implementation, and evaluation of PQC mechanisms within hybrid PQC–QKD security architectures.You will work closely with researchers and engineers to develop software modules, implement and evaluate cryptographic algorithms, and contribute to integrating PQC technologies with QKD and existing cryptographic systems, with a focus on security, interoperability, and real-world integration.Key Responsibilities• Design and implement software components for post-quantum cryptographic systems.• Integrate PQC algorithms into hybrid PQC–QKD security architectures.• Evaluate PQC algorithms, libraries and implementations for security, performance and integration suitability.• Contribute to the development of secure key establishment and hybrid cryptographic protocols, including hybrid key combination and key management mechanisms.• Collaborate with system engineers to integrate PQC components with QKD technologies and interoperability layers.• Perform functional, performance, security and interoperability testing of cryptographic implementations.• Prepare technical documentation and contribute to project deliverables and research reports.• Monitor developments in PQC standardization and emerging cryptographic research to ensure alignment with relevant standards and technological advances.Required Qualifications• Strong foundation in applied cryptography, with a solid understanding of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Cryptography, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.• Hands-on experience implementing, integrating or evaluating cryptographic algorithms and software libraries, preferably including PQC.• Familiarity with cryptographic protocols and secure key exchange mechanisms.• Strong programming skills in C/C++ or Rust, with Python experience considered an advantage.• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.• Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred Qualifications• Experience with PQC libraries, frameworks or NIST-standardised post-quantum algorithms.• Knowledge of network security protocols and key management systems.• Familiarity with quantum communication systems or QKD concepts• Experience working in research or R&D environments• Knowledge of hybrid cryptographic architectures, crypto-agility and interoperability between classical and post-quantum security technologies.What We Offer• Opportunity to work on challenging R&D projects at the intersection of post-quantum cryptography, quantum communications and cybersecurity.• An active role in technical development and engineering decisions within a growing deep-tech startup.• Collaboration with academic and research partners in the quantum technology ecosystem.• Direct contribution to the development of practical and interoperable quantum-safe communication technologies.How to ApplyIf you are passionate about cryptography and quantum-safe communications, we encourage you to apply.Please send your CV and a short cover letter explaining your interest in Post-QuantumCryptography and quantum cybersecurity to:  contact@luxquantum.luJoin us in building the future of quantum-safe communications.Études:  Master (Bac+5)
